可变长记录的槽位页（slotted page）及其空闲区间分配器。\n//!\n//! ## 空闲区模型\n//!\n//! 页内“可用区域”定义为 `[槽区前沿, 页末)`，即\n//! `[PAGE_HEADER_SIZE + nslots*8, DATA_END)`：已创建的槽位（无论存活还是\n//! 墓碑状态）都算作低端占用，记录占据数据区中的若干区间。对可用区域求存活\n//! 记录区间的补集，得到一组**互不相邻、已合并的空闲区间**。\n//!\n//! - **分配（分裂）**：在某个空闲区间高端切下记录所需字节，剩余部分留在低端；\n//!   若同时需要新槽位，则要求最低端那个与槽区前沿相邻的空闲区间再额外容纳 8B 槽项。\n//!   选择“剩余碎片最小”的候选（最佳适应）。\n//! - **释放（合并）**：槽位置墓碑（保留代次），该区间下次重算时自动与相邻空闲合并。\n//! - **压缩**：把所有存活记录搬到数据区顶端、首尾相接，合并为单一空闲区间；\n//!   槽号与代次均不变，因此所有有效句柄继续可用。\n\nuse crate::disk::{\n    finalize_page_crc, parse_page_header, read_u16, read_u32, slot_entry_offset, write_page_header,\n    write_u16, write_u32, DATA_END, DATA_START, MAX_RECORD, MAX_SLOTS, PAGE_HEADER_SIZE,\n    PAGE_SIZE, SLOT_ENTRY_SIZE,\n};\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\n\n/// 槽项：`off == 0` 表示空闲墓碑。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Slot {\n    pub off: u16,\n    pub len: u16,\n    pub gen: u32,\n}\n\nimpl Slot {\n    const DEAD: Slot = Slot {\n        off: 0,\n        len: 0,\n        gen: 0,\n    };\n\n    fn is_live(self) -> bool {\n        self.off != 0\n    }\n\n    fn interval(self) -> (u32, u32) {\n        (u32::from(self.off), u32::from(self.off) + u32::from(self.len))\n    }\n}\n\n/// 单页内存镜像。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct Frame {\n    pub page_id: u32,\n    pub slots: Vec<Slot>,\n    pub free_start: u16,\n    /// 整页字节镜像；记录字节真实存放在这里，encode 时组装。\n    data: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\n/// 记录句柄：页号 + 槽号 + 代次。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Handle {\n    pub page: u32,\n    pub slot: u16,\n    pub gen: u32,\n}\n\nimpl Handle {\n    /// 编码为线性格式 `p<u32>s<u16>g<u32>`。\n    pub fn encode(&self) -> String {\n        format!(\"p{}s{}g{}\", self.page, self.slot, self.gen)\n    }\n\n    /// 严格解析 `p<u32>s<u16>g<u32>`，三段缺一不可且不允许多余字符。\n    pub fn parse(s: &str) -> Result<Self> {\n        let bad = || Error::BadHandle(s.to_string());\n        let s = s.strip_prefix('p').ok_or_else(bad)?;\n        let (page, rest) = s.split_once('s').ok_or_else(bad)?;\n        let (slot, gen) = rest.split_once('g').ok_or_else(bad)?;\n        if page.is_empty() || slot.is_empty() || gen.is_empty() {\n            return Err(bad());\n        }\n        let parse = |x: &str| x.parse::<u64>().map_err(|_| bad());\n        let page = parse(page)?;\n        let slot = parse(slot)?;\n        let gen = parse(gen)?;\n        if page > u32::MAX as u64 || slot > u16::MAX as u64 || gen > u32::MAX as u64 {\n            return Err(bad());\n        }\n        Ok(Handle {\n            page: page as u32,\n            slot: slot as u16,\n            gen: gen as u32,\n        })\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Frame {\n    /// 创建一页空白页。\n    pub fn new(page_id: u32) -> Self {\n        Frame {\n            page_id,\n            slots: Vec::new(),\n            free_start: DATA_END as u16,\n            data: vec![0u8; PAGE_SIZE],\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 从磁盘帧解析（含魔数/CRC/区间合法性校验）。\n    pub fn decode(buf: &[u8]) -> Result<Self> {\n        let (page_id, nslots, free_start, live_count) = parse_page_header(buf)?;\n        let mut slots = Vec::with_capacity(nslots as usize);\n        for i in 0..nslots as usize {\n            let base = slot_entry_offset(i);\n            let off = read_u16(&buf[base..base + 2]);\n            let len = read_u16(&buf[base + 2..base + 4]);\n            let gen = read_u32(&buf[base + 4..base + 8]);\n            slots.push(Slot { off, len, gen });\n        }\n        // 校验存活槽的数据区范围与非零长度。\n        for (i, s) in slots.iter().enumerate() {\n            if s.is_live() {\n                let (a, b) = s.interval();\n                if (a as usize) < DATA_START || (b as usize) > DATA_END || s.len == 0 {\n                    return Err(Error::Corrupt(format!(\n                        \"page {page_id} slot {i} has bad record interval [{a}, {b})\"\n                    )));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        // 存活记录区间两两不得重叠（镜像损坏检测）。\n        let mut live: Vec<(u32, u32)> = slots.iter().filter(|s| s.is_live()).map(|s| s.interval()).collect();\n        live.sort_unstable();\n        for w in live.windows(2) {\n            if w[0].1 > w[1].0 {\n                return Err(Error::Corrupt(format!(\n                    \"page {page_id} has overlapping record intervals\"\n                )));\n            }\n        }\n        let actual_live = live.len() as u32;\n        if actual_live != live_count {\n            return Err(Error::Corrupt(format!(\n                \"page {page_id} header live_count={live_count} but found {actual_live} live slots\"\n            )));\n        }\n        Ok(Frame {\n            page_id,\n            slots,\n            free_start,\n            data: buf.to_vec(),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// 序列化为磁盘帧。\n    pub fn encode(&self) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let mut buf = self.data.clone();\n        // 头部/槽区不携带旧数据，统一清零后重建。\n        for b in buf[..DATA_START].iter_mut() {\n            *b = 0;\n        }\n        write_page_header(\n            &mut buf,\n            self.page_id,\n            self.slots.len() as u16,\n            self.free_start,\n            self.live_count() as u32,\n        );\n        for (i, s) in self.slots.iter().enumerate() {\n            let base = slot_entry_offset(i);\n            write_u16(&mut buf[base..base + 2], s.off);\n            write_u16(&mut buf[base + 2..base + 4], s.len);\n            write_u32(&mut buf[base + 4..base + 8], s.gen);\n        }\n        finalize_page_crc(&mut buf);\n        buf\n    }\n\n    /// 存活记录数。\n    pub fn live_count(&self) -> usize {\n        self.slots.iter().filter(|s| s.is_live()).count()\n    }\n\n    /// 已使用数据区字节数（存活记录之和）。\n    pub fn used_bytes(&self) -> usize {\n        self.slots\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| s.is_live())\n            .map(|s| s.len as usize)\n            .sum()\n    }\n\n    /// 槽区前沿（已创建槽位之后的第一个字节）。\n    fn slot_front(&self) -> u32 {\n        (PAGE_HEADER_SIZE + self.slots.len() * SLOT_ENTRY_SIZE) as u32\n    }\n\n    /// 重算 free_start（最低存活记录偏移；无记录则为 DATA_END）。\n    fn refresh_free_start(&mut self) {\n        self.free_start = self\n            .slots\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| s.is_live())\n            .map(|s| s.off)\n            .min()\n            .unwrap_or(DATA_END as u16);\n    }\n\n    /// 计算空闲区间（已排序、已合并）。区间低端起自槽区前沿，因此\n    /// 第一个区间同时可用于“新槽位 + 记录”的分配。\n    pub fn free_intervals(&self) -> Vec<(u32, u32)> {\n        let mut occupied: Vec<(u32, u32)> =\n            self.slots.iter().filter(|s| s.is_live()).map(|s| s.interval()).collect();\n        occupied.sort_unstable();\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        let mut cursor = self.slot_front();\n        for (a, b) in occupied {\n            if a > cursor {\n                out.push((cursor, a));\n            }\n            if b > cursor {\n                cursor = b;\n            }\n        }\n        if cursor < DATA_END as u32 {\n            out.push((cursor, DATA_END as u32));\n        }\n        out\n    }\n\n    /// 在页内分配一条记录。返回槽号与代次；空间不足返回 `None`。\n    ///\n    /// `data` 非空且不超过 [`MAX_RECORD`]（由上层保证）。\n    pub fn alloc(&mut self, data: &[u8]) -> Option<(u16, u32)> {\n        debug_assert!(!data.is_empty() && data.len() <= MAX_RECORD);\n        let need = data.len() as u32;\n        let free = self.free_intervals();\n\n        // 候选 1：复用任意墓碑槽（槽项本身不占空闲区间）。\n        let mut best: Option<(u32, /*slack*/ u32, usize, u32)> = None;\n        for (si, s) in self.slots.iter().enumerate() {\n            if s.is_live() {\n                continue;\n            }\n            if let Some(&(a, b)) = free.iter().find(|(a, b)| b - a >= need) {\n                let slack = (b - a) - need;\n                best = Some(match best {\n                    Some(cur) if cur.1 <= slack => cur,\n                    _ => (si as u32, slack, a, b),\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 候选 2：追加新槽位（仅使用与槽区前沿相邻的第一个空闲区间）。\n        if self.slots.len() < MAX_SLOTS {\n            if let Some(&(a, b)) = free.first() {\n                if a == self.slot_front() && b - a >= need + SLOT_ENTRY_SIZE as u32 {\n                    let slack = (b - a) - need - SLOT_ENTRY_SIZE as u32;\n                    best = Some(match best {\n                        // 同等碎片优先复用墓碑槽；否则选碎片更小者。\n                        Some(cur) if cur.1 <= slack => cur,\n                        _ => (self.slots.len() as u32, slack, a, b),\n                    });\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        let (slot_idx, _slack, _a, b) = best?;\n        let slot_idx = slot_idx as usize;\n        let off = (b - need) as u16;\n        let gen = if slot_idx < self.slots.len() {\n            // 复用墓碑槽：代次 +1，旧句柄立即失效。\n            let g = self.slots[slot_idx].gen.wrapping_add(1);\n            self.slots[slot_idx] = Slot {\n                off,\n                len: need as u16,\n                gen: g,\n            };\n            g\n        } else {\n            // 追加新槽：代次从 1 起步（墓碑状态 gen=0 永远不会等于有效句柄）。\n            debug_assert_eq!(slot_idx, self.slots.len());\n            self.slots.push(Slot {\n                off,\n                len: need as u16,\n                gen: 1,\n            });\n            1\n        };\n        self.data[off as usize..(off as usize) + data.len()].copy_from_slice(data);\n        self.refresh_free_start();\n        Some((slot_idx as u16, gen))\n    }\n\n    /// 按句柄读取记录。\n    pub fn get(&self, slot: u16, gen: u32) -> Result<&[u8]> {\n        let s = *self\n            .slots\n            .get(slot as usize)\n            .ok_or(Error::SlotNotFound(self.page_id, slot))?;\n        if !s.is_live() {\n            return Err(self.dead_error(slot, gen, s.gen));\n        }\n        if s.gen != gen {\n            return Err(Error::StaleHandle {\n                page: self.page_id,\n                slot,\n                handle_gen: gen,\n                current_gen: s.gen,\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(&self.data[s.off as usize..s.off as usize + s.len as usize])\n    }\n\n    /// 按句柄释放记录。\n    pub fn free_slot(&mut self, slot: u16, gen: u32) -> Result<()> {\n        let page_id = self.page_id;\n        let s = *self\n            .slots\n            .get(slot as usize)\n            .ok_or(Error::SlotNotFound(page_id, slot))?;\n        if !s.is_live() {\n            return Err(self.dead_error(slot, gen, s.gen));\n        }\n        if s.gen != gen {\n            return Err(Error::StaleHandle {\n                page: page_id,\n                slot,\n                handle_gen: gen,\n                current_gen: s.gen,\n            });\n        }\n        // 清零记录字节，避免释放后的旧数据残留在重写镜像中。\n        for b in &mut self.data[s.off as usize..s.off as usize + s.len as usize] {\n            *b = 0;\n        }\n        self.slots[slot as usize] = Slot {\n            off: 0,\n            len: 0,\n            gen, // 代次保留：旧句柄表现为“已释放”，复用后表现为“已过期”。\n        };\n        self.refresh_free_start();\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn dead_error(&self, slot: u16, handle_gen: u32, tomb_gen: u32) -> Error {\n        if tomb_gen == handle_gen {\n            Error::AlreadyFreed {\n                page: self.page_id,\n                slot,\n                gen: handle_gen,\n            }\n        } else {\n            Error::StaleHandle {\n                page: self.page_id,\n                slot,\n                handle_gen,\n                current_gen: tomb_gen,\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 压缩页：存活记录移动到数据区高端首尾相接，合并全部空闲区间。\n    /// 槽号、代次、记录内容均不变；返回是否发生了搬移。\n    pub fn compact(&mut self) -> bool {\n        if self.live_count() == 0 {\n            // 无存活记录：数据区清零，所有槽位置为同代次墓碑。\n            let changed = self.used_bytes() != 0 || self.free_start != DATA_END as u16;\n            for b in self.data[DATA_START..DATA_END].iter_mut() {\n                *b = 0;\n            }\n            for s in self.slots.iter_mut() {\n                *s = Slot {\n                    off: 0,\n                    len: 0,\n                    gen: s.gen,\n                };\n            }\n            self.free_start = DATA_END as u16;\n            return changed;\n        }\n\n        // 先取出存活 (槽索引, 旧区间, 代次)，按槽号顺序摆放。\n        let mut live: Vec<(usize, u16, u32, Vec<u8>)> = self\n            .slots\n            .iter()\n            .enumerate()\n            .filter(|(_, s)| s.is_live())\n            .map(|(i, s)| {\n                (\n                    i,\n                    s.len,\n                    s.gen,\n                    self.data[s.off as usize..s.off as usize + s.len as usize].to_vec(),\n                )\n            })\n            .collect();\n\n        let before: Vec<(u16, u16)> = self\n            .slots\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| s.is_live())\n            .map(|s| (s.off, s.len))\n            .collect();\n\n        // 数据区整体清零后，从页末向下依次摆放（槽号 0 位于最高端）。\n        for b in self.data[DATA_START..DATA_END].iter_mut() {\n            *b = 0;\n        }\n        let mut cursor = DATA_END;\n        for (i, len, _gen, bytes) in live.iter_mut() {\n            cursor -= *len as usize;\n            self.data[cursor..cursor + *len as usize].copy_from_slice(bytes);\n            self.slots[*i] = Slot {\n                off: cursor as u16,\n                len: *len,\n                gen: *self.slots.get(*i).map(|s| s.gen).unwrap_or(self.slots[*i].gen),\n            };\n        }\n        let gen_snapshot: Vec<u32> = self\n            .slots\n            .iter()\n            .enumerate()\n            .filter(|(_, s)| s.is_live())\n            .map(|(_, s)| s.gen)\n            .collect();\n        // 上一行重新借用造成 gen 字段移动语义不直观，用快照做一次确定性校正：\n        for ((i, _, gen, _), g) in std::iter::zip(live.iter(), gen_snapshot) {\n            debug_assert_eq!(self.slots[*i].gen, g);\n            let _ = gen;\n        }\n        self.refresh_free_start();\n\n        let after: Vec<(u16, u16)> = self\n            .slots\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| s.is_live())\n            .map(|s| (s.off, s.len))\n            .collect();\n        before != after\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn handle_roundtrip_and_parse() {\n        let h = Handle {\n            page: 7,\n            slot: 3,\n            gen: 42,\n        };\n        assert_eq!(Handle::parse(&h.encode()).unwrap(), h);\n        assert!(Handle::parse(\"p1s2\").is_err());\n        assert!(Handle::parse(\"x1s2g3\").is_err());\n        assert!(Handle::parse(\"p1s2g3x\").is_err());\n        assert!(Handle::parse(\"p\").is_err());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn alloc_free_split_merge_reuse() {\n        let mut pg = Frame::new(0);\n        let h1 = pg.alloc(b\"aaaa\").unwrap();\n        let h2 = pg.alloc(b\"bbbbbb\").unwrap();\n        let h3 = pg.alloc(b\"cc\").unwrap();\n        // 三个独立区间 + 低端中央区间 = 4 段空闲。\n        assert_eq!(pg.free_intervals().len(), 4);\n        // 释放中间记录：孔洞先出现，再被相邻释放合并。\n        pg.free_slot(h2.0, h2.1).unwrap();\n        assert!(pg\n            .free_intervals()\n            .iter()\n            .any(|(a, b)| b - a == 6));\n        pg.free_slot(h1.0, h1.1).unwrap();\n        // h1 与 h2 的孔洞相邻（h1 在更高地址），应合并为 10 字节区间。\n        assert!(pg\n            .free_intervals()\n            .iter()\n            .any(|(a, b)| b - a == 10), \"intervals: {:?}\", pg.free_intervals());\n        pg.free_slot(h3.0, h3.1).unwrap();\n        // 全部释放后只剩一个（中央）空闲区间。\n        assert_eq!(pg.free_intervals().len(), 1);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn generation_guards() {\n        let mut pg = Frame::new(5);\n        let (s, g) = pg.alloc(b\"hello\").unwrap();\n        assert!(pg.get(s, g).is_ok());\n        // 旧代次读存活槽 → stale。\n        assert!(matches!(\n            pg.get(s, g.wrapping_sub(1)),\n            Err(Error::StaleHandle { .. })\n        ));\n        pg.free_slot(s, g).unwrap();\n        // 原句柄重复释放/读取 → already freed。\n        assert!(matches!(\n            pg.free_slot(s, g),\n            Err(Error::AlreadyFreed { .. })\n        ));\n        assert!(matches!(pg.get(s, g), Err(Error::AlreadyFreed { .. })));\n        // 槽位复用后，旧句柄 → stale（不会读到新记录）。\n        let (s2, g2) = pg.alloc(b\"world!!\").unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(s2, s);\n        assert_ne!(g2, g);\n        assert!(matches!(pg.get(s, g), Err(Error::StaleHandle { .. })));\n        assert_eq!(pg.get(s2, g2).unwrap(), b\"world!!\");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn compact_preserves_handles() {\n        let mut pg = Frame::new(1);\n        let mut handles = Vec::new();\n        for i in 0u8..20 {\n            let (s, g) = pg.alloc(&[b'x' + i; 100]).unwrap();\n            handles.push((s, g, [b'x' + i; 100]));\n        }\n        // 制造碎片：释放偶数号槽。\n        for (i, (s, g, _)) in handles.iter().enumerate() {\n            if i % 2 == 0 {\n                pg.free_slot(*s, *g).unwrap();\n            }\n        }\n        assert!(pg.free_intervals().len() > 2);\n        pg.compact();\n        // 压缩后只剩一个空闲区间。\n        assert_eq!(pg.free_intervals().len(), 1);\n        // 存活句柄仍有效且内容一致；已释放句柄仍报错。\n        for (i, (s, g, payload)) in handles.iter().enumerate() {\n            if i % 2 == 1 {\n                assert_eq!(pg.get(*s, *g).unwrap(), payload.as_slice());\n            } else {\n                assert!(pg.get(*s, *g).is_err());\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn encode_decode_roundtrip() {\n        let mut pg = Frame::new(9);\n        let h = pg.alloc(b\"persistent\").unwrap();\n        pg.alloc(b\"record-two\").unwrap();\n        pg.free_slot(h.0, h.1).unwrap();\n        let buf = pg.encode();\n        let pg2 = Frame::decode(&buf).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(pg2.page_id, 9);\n        assert_eq!(pg2.slots.len(), pg.slots.len());\n        assert_eq!(pg2.free_intervals(), pg.free_intervals());\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_8be2884da18ca6ce6b54e455","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":3405,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":41784,"output_tokens":7510,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_8metq04cbe8c0nvbuzqz7m2v":{"content":"//! 可变长记录的槽位页（slotted page）及其空闲区间分配器。\n//!\n//! ## 空闲区模型\n//!\n//! 页内“可用区域”定义为 `[槽区前沿, 页末)`，即\n//! `[PAGE_HEADER_SIZE + nslots*8, DATA_END)`：已创建的槽位（无论存活还是\n//! 墓碑状态）都算作低端占用，记录占据数据区中的若干区间。对可用区域求存活\n//! 记录区间的补集，得到一组**互不相邻、已合并的空闲区间**。\n//!\n//! - **分配（分裂）**：在某个空闲区间高端切下记录所需字节，剩余部分留在低端；\n//!   若同时需要新槽位，则要求最低端那个与槽区前沿相邻的空闲区间再额外容纳 8B 槽项。\n//!   选择“剩余碎片最小”的候选（最佳适应）。\n//! - **释放（合并）**：槽位置墓碑（保留代次），该区间下次重算时自动与相邻空闲合并。\n//! - **压缩**：把所有存活记录搬到数据区顶端、首尾相接，合并为单一空闲区间；\n//!   槽号与代次均不变，因此所有有效句柄继续可用。\n\nuse crate::disk::{\n    finalize_page_crc, parse_page_header, read_u16, read_u32, slot_entry_offset, write_page_header,\n    write_u16, write_u32, DATA_END, DATA_START, MAX_RECORD, MAX_SLOTS, PAGE_HEADER_SIZE,\n    PAGE_SIZE, SLOT_ENTRY_SIZE,\n};\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\n\n/// 槽项：`off == 0` 表示空闲墓碑。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Slot {\n    pub off: u16,\n    pub len: u16,\n    pub gen: u32,\n}\n\nimpl Slot {\n    const DEAD: Slot = Slot {\n        off: 0,\n        len: 0,\n        gen: 0,\n    };\n\n    fn is_live(self) -> bool {\n        self.off != 0\n    }\n\n    fn interval(self) -> (u32, u32) {\n        (u32::from(self.off), u32::from(self.off) + u32::from(self.len))\n    }\n}\n\n/// 单页内存镜像。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct Frame {\n    pub page_id: u32,\n    pub slots: Vec<Slot>,\n    pub free_start: u16,\n    /// 整页字节镜像；记录字节真实存放在这里，encode 时组装。\n    data: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\n/// 记录句柄：页号 + 槽号 + 代次。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Handle {\n    pub page: u32,\n    pub slot: u16,\n    pub gen: u32,\n}\n\nimpl Handle {\n    /// 编码为线性格式 `p<u32>s<u16>g<u32>`。\n    pub fn encode(&self) -> String {\n        format!(\"p{}s{}g{}\", self.page, self.slot, self.gen)\n    }\n\n    /// 严格解析 `p<u32>s<u16>g<u32>`，三段缺一不可且不允许多余字符。\n    pub fn parse(s: &str) -> Result<Self> {\n        let bad = || Error::BadHandle(s.to_string());\n        let s = s.strip_prefix('p').ok_or_else(bad)?;\n        let (page, rest) = s.split_once('s').ok_or_else(bad)?;\n        let (slot, gen) = rest.split_once('g').ok_or_else(bad)?;\n        if page.is_empty() || slot.is_empty() || gen.is_empty() {\n            return Err(bad());\n        }\n        let parse = |x: &str| x.parse::<u64>().map_err(|_| bad());\n        let page = parse(page)?;\n        let slot = parse(slot)?;\n        let gen = parse(gen)?;\n        if page > u32::MAX as u64 || slot > u16::MAX as u64 || gen > u32::MAX as u64 {\n            return Err(bad());\n        }\n        Ok(Handle {\n            page: page as u32,\n            slot: slot as u16,\n            gen: gen as u32,\n        })\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Frame {\n    /// 创建一页空白页。\n    pub fn new(page_id: u32) -> Self {\n        Frame {\n            page_id,\n            slots: Vec::new(),\n            free_start: DATA_END as u16,\n            data: vec![0u8; PAGE_SIZE],\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 从磁盘帧解析（含魔数/CRC/区间合法性校验）。\n    pub fn decode(buf: &[u8]) -> Result<Self> {\n        let (page_id, nslots, free_start, live_count) = parse_page_header(buf)?;\n        let mut slots = Vec::with_capacity(nslots as usize);\n        for i in 0..nslots as usize {\n            let base = slot_entry_offset(i);\n            let off = read_u16(&buf[base..base + 2]);\n            let len = read_u16(&buf[base + 2..base + 4]);\n            let gen = read_u32(&buf[base + 4..base + 8]);\n            slots.push(Slot { off, len, gen });\n        }\n        // 校验存活槽的数据区范围与非零长度。\n        for (i, s) in slots.iter().enumerate() {\n            if s.is_live() {\n                let (a, b) = s.interval();\n                if (a as usize) < DATA_START || (b as usize) > DATA_END || s.len == 0 {\n                    return Err(Error::Corrupt(format!(\n                        \"page {page_id} slot {i} has bad record interval [{a}, {b})\"\n                    )));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        // 存活记录区间两两不得重叠（镜像损坏检测）。\n        let mut live: Vec<(u32, u32)> = slots.iter().filter(|s| s.is_live()).map(|s| s.interval()).collect();\n        live.sort_unstable();\n        for w in live.windows(2) {\n            if w[0].1 > w[1].0 {\n                return Err(Error::Corrupt(format!(\n                    \"page {page_id} has overlapping record intervals\"\n                )));\n            }\n        }\n        let actual_live = live.len() as u32;\n        if actual_live != live_count {\n            return Err(Error::Corrupt(format!(\n                \"page {page_id} header live_count={live_count} but found {actual_live} live slots\"\n            )));\n        }\n        Ok(Frame {\n            page_id,\n            slots,\n            free_start,\n            data: buf.to_vec(),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// 序列化为磁盘帧。\n    pub fn encode(&self) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let mut buf = self.data.clone();\n        // 头部/槽区不携带旧数据，统一清零后重建。\n        for b in buf[..DATA_START].iter_mut() {\n            *b = 0;\n        }\n        write_page_header(\n            &mut buf,\n            self.page_id,\n            self.slots.len() as u16,\n            self.free_start,\n            self.live_count() as u32,\n        );\n        for (i, s) in self.slots.iter().enumerate() {\n            let base = slot_entry_offset(i);\n            write_u16(&mut buf[base..base + 2], s.off);\n            write_u16(&mut buf[base + 2..base + 4], s.len);\n            write_u32(&mut buf[base + 4..base + 8], s.gen);\n        }\n        finalize_page_crc(&mut buf);\n        buf\n    }\n\n    /// 存活记录数。\n    pub fn live_count(&self) -> usize {\n        self.slots.iter().filter(|s| s.is_live()).count()\n    }\n\n    /// 已使用数据区字节数（存活记录之和）。\n    pub fn used_bytes(&self) -> usize {\n        self.slots\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| s.is_live())\n            .map(|s| s.len as usize)\n            .sum()\n    }\n\n    /// 槽区前沿（已创建槽位之后的第一个字节）。\n    fn slot_front(&self) -> u32 {\n        (PAGE_HEADER_SIZE + self.slots.len() * SLOT_ENTRY_SIZE) as u32\n    }\n\n    /// 重算 free_start（最低存活记录偏移；无记录则为 DATA_END）。\n    fn refresh_free_start(&mut self) {\n        self.free_start = self\n            .slots\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| s.is_live())\n            .map(|s| s.off)\n            .min()\n            .unwrap_or(DATA_END as u16);\n    }\n\n    /// 计算空闲区间（已排序、已合并）。区间低端起自槽区前沿，因此\n    /// 第一个区间同时可用于“新槽位 + 记录”的分配。\n    pub fn free_intervals(&self) -> Vec<(u32, u32)> {\n        let mut occupied: Vec<(u32, u32)> =\n            self.slots.iter().filter(|s| s.is_live()).map(|s| s.interval()).collect();\n        occupied.sort_unstable();\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        let mut cursor = self.slot_front();\n        for (a, b) in occupied {\n            if a > cursor {\n                out.push((cursor, a));\n            }\n            if b > cursor {\n                cursor = b;\n            }\n        }\n        if cursor < DATA_END as u32 {\n            out.push((cursor, DATA_END as u32));\n        }\n        out\n    }\n\n    /// 在页内分配一条记录。返回槽号与代次；空间不足返回 `None`。\n    ///\n    /// `data` 非空且不超过 [`MAX_RECORD`]（由上层保证）。\n    pub fn alloc(&mut self, data: &[u8]) -> Option<(u16, u32)> {\n        debug_assert!(!data.is_empty() && data.len() <= MAX_RECORD);\n        let need = data.len() as u32;\n        let free = self.free_intervals();\n\n        // 候选 1：复用任意墓碑槽（槽项本身不占空闲区间）。\n        let mut best: Option<(u32, /*slack*/ u32, usize, u32)> = None;\n        for (si, s) in self.slots.iter().enumerate() {\n            if s.is_live() {\n                continue;\n            }\n            if let Some(&(a, b)) = free.iter().find(|(a, b)| b - a >= need) {\n                let slack = (b - a) - need;\n                best = Some(match best {\n                    Some(cur) if cur.1 <= slack => cur,\n                    _ => (si as u32, slack, a, b),\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 候选 2：追加新槽位（仅使用与槽区前沿相邻的第一个空闲区间）。\n        if self.slots.len() < MAX_SLOTS {\n            if let Some(&(a, b)) = free.first() {\n                if a == self.slot_front() && b - a >= need + SLOT_ENTRY_SIZE as u32 {\n                    let slack = (b - a) - need - SLOT_ENTRY_SIZE as u32;\n                    best = Some(match best {\n                        // 同等碎片优先复用墓碑槽；否则选碎片更小者。\n                        Some(cur) if cur.1 <= slack => cur,\n                        _ => (self.slots.len() as u32, slack, a, b),\n                    });\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        let (slot_idx, _slack, _a, b) = best?;\n        let slot_idx = slot_idx as usize;\n        let off = (b - need) as u16;\n        let gen = if slot_idx < self.slots.len() {\n            // 复用墓碑槽：代次 +1，旧句柄立即失效。\n            let g = self.slots[slot_idx].gen.wrapping_add(1);\n            self.slots[slot_idx] = Slot {\n                off,\n                len: need as u16,\n                gen: g,\n            };\n            g\n        } else {\n            // 追加新槽：代次从 1 起步（墓碑状态 gen=0 永远不会等于有效句柄）。\n            debug_assert_eq!(slot_idx, self.slots.len());\n            self.slots.push(Slot {\n                off,\n                len: need as u16,\n                gen: 1,\n            });\n            1\n        };\n        self.data[off as usize..(off as usize) + data.len()].copy_from_slice(data);\n        self.refresh_free_start();\n        Some((slot_idx as u16, gen))\n    }\n\n    /// 按句柄读取记录。\n    pub fn get(&self, slot: u16, gen: u32) -> Result<&[u8]> {\n        let s = *self\n            .slots\n            .get(slot as usize)\n            .ok_or(Error::SlotNotFound(self.page_id, slot))?;\n        if !s.is_live() {\n            return Err(self.dead_error(slot, gen, s.gen));\n        }\n        if s.gen != gen {\n            return Err(Error::StaleHandle {\n                page: self.page_id,\n                slot,\n                handle_gen: gen,\n                current_gen: s.gen,\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(&self.data[s.off as usize..s.off as usize + s.len as usize])\n    }\n\n    /// 按句柄释放记录。\n    pub fn free_slot(&mut self, slot: u16, gen: u32) -> Result<()> {\n        let page_id = self.page_id;\n        let s = *self\n            .slots\n            .get(slot as usize)\n            .ok_or(Error::SlotNotFound(page_id, slot))?;\n        if !s.is_live() {\n            return Err(self.dead_error(slot, gen, s.gen));\n        }\n        if s.gen != gen {\n            return Err(Error::StaleHandle {\n                page: page_id,\n                slot,\n                handle_gen: gen,\n                current_gen: s.gen,\n            });\n        }\n        // 清零记录字节，避免释放后的旧数据残留在重写镜像中。\n        for b in &mut self.data[s.off as usize..s.off as usize + s.len as usize] {\n            *b = 0;\n        }\n        self.slots[slot as usize] = Slot {\n            off: 0,\n            len: 0,\n            gen, // 代次保留：旧句柄表现为“已释放”，复用后表现为“已过期”。\n        };\n        self.refresh_free_start();\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn dead_error(&self, slot: u16, handle_gen: u32, tomb_gen: u32) -> Error {\n        if tomb_gen == handle_gen {\n            Error::AlreadyFreed {\n                page: self.page_id,\n                slot,\n                gen: handle_gen,\n            }\n        } else {\n            Error::StaleHandle {\n                page: self.page_id,\n                slot,\n                handle_gen,\n                current_gen: tomb_gen,\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 压缩页：存活记录移动到数据区高端首尾相接，合并全部空闲区间。\n    /// 槽号、代次、记录内容均不变；返回是否发生了搬移。\n    pub fn compact(&mut self) -> bool {\n        if self.live_count() == 0 {\n            // 无存活记录：数据区清零，所有槽位置为同代次墓碑。\n            let changed = self.used_bytes() != 0 || self.free_start != DATA_END as u16;\n            for b in self.data[DATA_START..DATA_END].iter_mut() {\n                *b = 0;\n            }\n            for s in self.slots.iter_mut() {\n                *s = Slot {\n                    off: 0,\n                    len: 0,\n                    gen: s.gen,\n                };\n            }\n            self.free_start = DATA_END as u16;\n            return changed;\n        }\n\n        // 先取出存活 (槽索引, 旧区间, 代次)，按槽号顺序摆放。\n        let mut live: Vec<(usize, u16, u32, Vec<u8>)> = self\n            .slots\n            .iter()\n            .enumerate()\n            .filter(|(_, s)| s.is_live())\n            .map(|(i, s)| {\n                (\n                    i,\n                    s.len,\n                    s.gen,\n                    self.data[s.off as usize..s.off as usize + s.len as usize].to_vec(),\n                )\n            })\n {\n                off: cursor as u16,\n                len: *len,\n                gen: *self.slots.get(*i).map(|s| s.gen).unwrap_or(self.slots[*i].gen),\n            };\n        }\n        let gen_snapshot: Vec<u32> = self\n            .slots\n            .iter()\n            .enumerate()\n            .filter(|(_, s)| s.is_live())\n            .map(|(_, s)| s.gen)\n            .collect();\n        // 上一行重新借用造成 gen 字段移动语义不直观，用快照做一次确定性校正：\n        for ((i, _, gen, _), g) in std::iter::zip(live.iter(), gen_snapshot) {\n            debug_assert_eq!(self.slots[*i].gen, g);\n            let _ = gen;\n        }\n        self.refresh_free_start();\n\n        let after: Vec<(u16, u16)> = self\n            .slots\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| s.is_live())\n            .map(|s| (s.off, s.len))\n            .collect();\n        before != after\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn handle_roundtrip_and_parse() {\n        let h = assert!(Handle::parse(\"p1s2\").is_err());\n        assert!(Handle::parse(\"x1s2g3\").is_err());\n        assert!(Handle::parse(\"p1s2g3x\").is_err());\n        assert!(Handle::parse(\"p\").is_err());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn alloc_free_split_merge_reuse() {\n        let mut pg = Frame::new(0);\n        let h1 = pg.alloc(b\"aaaa\").unwrap();\n        let generation_guards() {\n        let mut pg = Frame::new(5);\n        let (s, g) = pg.alloc(b\"hello\").unwrap();\n        assert!(pg.get(s, g).is_ok());\n        // 旧代次读存活槽 → stale。\n 可变长记录的槽位页（slotted page）及其空闲区间分配器。\n//!\n//! ## 空闲区模型\n//!\n//! 页内“可用区域”定义为 `[槽区前沿, 页末)`，即\n//! `[PAGE_HEADER_SIZE + nslots*8, DATA_END)`：已创建的槽位（无论存活还是\n//! 墓碑状态）都算作低端占用，记录占据数据区中的若干区间。对可用区域求存活\n//! 记录区间的补集，得到一组**互不相邻、已合并的空闲区间**。\n//!\n//! - **分配（分裂）**：在某个空闲区间高端切下记录所需字节，剩余部分留在低端；\n//!   若同时需要新槽位，则要求最低端那个与槽区前沿相邻的空闲区间再额外容纳 8B 槽项。\n//!   选择“剩余碎片最小”的候选（最佳适应）。\n//! - **释放（合并）**：槽位置墓碑（保留代次），该区间下次重算时自动与相邻空闲合并。\n//! - **压缩**：把所有存活记录搬到数据区顶端、首尾相接，合并为单一空闲区间；\n//!   槽号与代次均不变，因此所有有效句柄继续可用。\n\nuse crate::disk::{\n    finalize_page_crc, parse_page_header, read_u16, read_u32, slot_entry_offset, write_page_header,\n    write_u16, write_u32, DATA_END, DATA_START, MAX_RECORD, MAX_SLOTS, PAGE_HEADER_SIZE,\n    PAGE_SIZE, SLOT_ENTRY_SIZE,\n};\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\n\n/// 槽项：`off == 0` 表示空闲墓碑。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Slot {\n    pub off: u16,\n    pub len: u16,\n    pub gen: u32,\n}\n\nimpl Slot {\n    const DEAD: Slot = Slot {\n        off: 0,\n        len: 0,\n        gen: 0,\n    };\n\n    fn is_live(self) -> bool {\n        self.off != 0\n    }\n\n    fn interval(self) -> (u32, u32) {\n        (u32::from(self.off), u32::from(self.off) + u32::from(self.len))\n    }\n}\n\n/// 单页内存镜像。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct Frame {\n    pub page_id: u32,\n    pub slots: Vec<Slot>,\n    pub free_start: u16,\n    /// 整页字节镜像；记录字节真实存放在这里，encode 时组装。\n    data: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\n/// 记录句柄：页号 + 槽号 + 代次。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Handle {\n    pub page: u32,\n    pub slot: u16,\n    pub gen: u32,\n}\n\nimpl Handle {\n    /// 编码为线性格式 `p<u32>s<u16>g<u32>`。\n    pub fn encode(&self) -> String {\n        format!(\"p{}s{}g{}\", self.page, self.slot, self.gen)\n    }\n\n    /// 严格解析 `p<u32>s<u16>g<u32>`，三段缺一不可且不允许多余字符。\n    pub fn parse(s: &str) -> Result<Self> {\n        let bad = || Error::BadHandle(s.to_string());\n        let s = s.strip_prefix('p').ok_or_else(bad)?;\n        let (page, rest) = s.split_once('s').ok_or_else(bad)?;\n        let (slot, gen) = rest.split_once('g').ok_or_else(bad)?;\n        if page.is_empty() || {"parentUuid":"24132413-2943-4d27-9a4b-3b89b98cae6a","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_bwfaxxkg2je8ktoewp26x6t1","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/a/src/io.rs","content":"//! 可注入的存储 I/O 层。\n//!\n//! - [`StorageIo`]：按帧号读写固定大小帧、显式 sync 的抽象。\n//! - [`FileStorage`]：真实文件后端，`pread/pwrite` 定位写，`fsync` 落盘。\n//! - [`MemStorage`]：内存后端，用于确定性测试。\n//! - [`FaultyStorage`]：故障注入包装，可在第 N 次 read/write/sync 注入\n//!   I/O 错误，或把某次写变成只落半页的**撕裂写**。\n\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::fs::{File, OpenOptions};\nuse std::io;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse std::os::unix::fs::FileExt;\n\nuse crate::disk::PAGE_SIZE;\n\n/// 帧存储抽象。`frame_no` 即帧号（0 为超级块，页号 = 数据页帧号）。\npub trait StorageIo: Send + Sync {\n    /// 将恰好一帧读入 `buf`（长度必须为 [`PAGE_SIZE`]）；越过文件尾返回 EOF 错误。\n    fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 将一帧写入指定帧号（部分长度也允许，用于模拟撕裂写）。\n    fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 强制把已写入的数据刷到物理介质。\n    fn sync(&self) -> io::Result<()>;\n}\n\nimpl<S: StorageIo + ?Sized> StorageIo for Box<S> {\n    fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        (**self).read_frame(frame_no, buf)\n    }\n    fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        (**self).write_frame(frame_no, data)\n    }\n    fn sync(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        (**self).sync()\n    }\n}\n\n/// 真实文件后端。\npub struct FileStorage {\n    file: File,\n}\n\nimpl FileStorage {\n    /// 创建全新的空存储文件（要求路径不存在）。\n    pub fn create(path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> io::Result<Self> {\n        if let Some(parent) = path.as_ref().parent() {\n            if !parent.as_os_str().is_empty() {\n                std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;\n            }\n        }\n        let file = OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .create_new(true)\n            .open(path)?;\n        Ok(FileStorage { file })\n    }\n\n    /// 打开已有存储文件。\n    pub fn open(path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> io::Result<Self> {\n        let file = OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .open(path)?;\n        Ok(FileStorage { file })\n    }\n}\n\nimpl StorageIo for FileStorage {\n    fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        debug_assert_eq!(buf.len(), PAGE_SIZE);\n        let off = frame_no * PAGE_SIZE as u64;\n        let n = self.file.read_at(buf, off)?;\n        if n != buf.len() {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(\n                io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof,\n                format!(\"short read at frame {frame_no}: {n}/{PAGE_SIZE} bytes\"),\n            ));\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        debug_assert!(data.len() <= PAGE_SIZE);\n        let off = frame_no * PAGE_SIZE as u64;\n        self.file.write_all_at(data, off)\n    }\n\n    fn sync(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.file.sync_all()\n    }\n}\n\n/// 纯内存后端：帧号 -> 字节。写半帧会真的只存半帧，因此撕裂写可被 CRC 检出。\n#[derive(Default)]\npub struct MemStorage {\n    frames: Mutex<HashMap<u64, Vec<u8>>>,\n    sync_count: Mutex<u64>,\n}\n\nimpl MemStorage {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        Self::default()\n    }\n\n    pub fn sync_count(&self) -> u64 {\n        *self.sync_count.lock().unwrap()\n    }\n\n    /// 快照（帧号排序），供测试检查磁盘镜像。\n    pub fn snapshot(&self) -> Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)> {\n        let frames = self.frames.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut v: Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)> =\n            frames.iter().map(|(k, v)| (*k, v.clone())).collect();\n        v.sort_by_key(|(k, _)| *k);\n        v\n    }\n}\n\nimpl StorageIo for MemStorage {\n    fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        debug_assert_eq!(buf.len(), PAGE_SIZE);\n        let frames = self.frames.lock().unwrap();\n        let frame = frames.get(&frame_no).ok_or_else(|| {\n            io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof, format!(\"no frame {frame_no}\"))\n        })?;\n        if frame.len() != buf.len() {\n            // 典型场景：该帧被撕裂写成半帧。\n            return Err(io::Error::new(\n                io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                format!(\n self.plan.lock().unwrap().fail_read_at == Some(n) {\n            return Err(Self::io_err(\"read failure\"));\n        }\n        self.inner.read_frame(frame_no, buf)\n    }\n\n    fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let n = {\n            let mut c = self.counters.lock().unwrap();\n            c.writes += 1;\n            c.writes\n        };\n        let plan = self.plan.lock().unwrap().clone();\n        if plan.fail_write_at == Some(n) {\n            return Err(Self::io_err(\"write failure\"));\n        }\n        if plan.torn_write_at == Some(n) {\n            // 只把前半帧交给内层：后半保持旧值/零，CRC 必然失配。\n            let half = data.len() / 2;\n            self.inner.write_frame(frame_no, &data[..half])?;\n            self.counters.lock().unwrap().torn += 1;\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        self.inner.write_frame(frame_no, data)\n    }\n\n    fn sync(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let n = {\n            let mut c = self.counters.lock().unwrap();\n            c.syncs += 1;\n            c.syncs\n        };\n        if self.plan.lock().unwrap().fail_sync_at == Some(n) {\n            return Err(Self::io_err(\"sync failure\"));\n        }\n        self.inner.sync()\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"5ace9d21-e388-42dc-a077-f752bfc074a0","session_id":"728b6c9b-b77e-419f-ac5e-f62a72c8fe54","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/a","sessionId":"728b6c9b-b77e-419f-ac5e-f62a72c8fe54","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp9-a","slug":"temporal-snacking-panda"}

{"parentUuid":"78afe5c8-d737-4fba-a0d8-5c72fd83096d","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_yg3ppfdv5w08lq3dwyd8xs3u","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/a/src/store.rs","content":"//! 存储管理器：跨页分配、句柄校验、压缩、持久性边界。\n//!\n//! ## 同步（持久性）边界\n//!\n//! 所有变更（put/free/compact）都是 **write-through**：内存状态只在对应的\n//! `write_frame` 成功后才更新，因此出错时内存与磁盘保持一致（见\n//! [`Frame`]“先在克隆上修改、写成功后替换”的做法）。但普通 write 只把数据\n//! 交给操作系统页缓存，掉电可能丢失；只有显式调用 [`Store::sync`]\n//! （HTTP `POST /sync`）才执行底层 fsync，获得崩溃持久性保证。\n//!\n//! 新页分配的写入顺序为：**先写新页帧，再写超级块提升 npages**。这样超级块\n//! 引用到的页帧必然已写入；若超级块写失败，新帧只会成为不可达的孤儿帧，\n//! 不会出现“引用了半初始化页”的情况。\n\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse crate::disk::{SuperBlock, MAX_RECORD, PAGE_SIZE};\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::io::StorageIo;\nuse crate::page::{Frame, Handle};\n\n/// 线程安全的存储管理器。\npub struct Store {\n    inner: Mutex<Inner>,\n}\n\nstruct Inner {\n    io: Arc<dyn StorageIo>,\n    sb: SuperBlock,\n    pages: BTreeMap<u32, Frame>,\n}\n\n/// 单页布局信息（供 HTTP 检查接口与参考模型校验使用）。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct PageInfo {\n    pub page: u32,\n    pub nslots: usize,\n    pub live: usize,\n    pub used_bytes: usize,\n    pub free_start: u16,\n    /// 空闲区间（已合并），元素为 `[start,end)`。\n    pub free_intervals: Vec<(u32, u32)>,\n}\n\n/// 全局状态快照。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct Status {\n    pub npages: u32,\n    pub live_records: usize,\n    pub used_bytes: usize,\n    pub max_records: usize,\n    pub page_size: usize,\n    pub data_bytes_per_page: usize,\n}\n\nimpl Store {\n    /// 在全新（空）后端上创建存储，写入初始超级块。\n    pub fn create(io: Arc<dyn StorageIo>) -> Result<Self> {\n        let sb = SuperBlock { npages: 0 };\n        io.write_frame(0, &sb.encode())?;\n        Ok(Store {\n            inner: Mutex::new(Inner {\n                io,\n                sb,\n                pages: BTreeMap::new(),\n            }),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// 打开已有后端：读取超级块并急加载全部数据页（含 CRC 校验）。\n    pub fn open(io: Arc<dyn StorageIo>) -> Result<Self> {\n        let mut buf = vec![0u8; PAGE_SIZE];\n        io.read_frame(0, &mut buf)?;\n        let sb = SuperBlock::decode(&buf)?;\n        let mut pages = BTreeMap::new();\n        for pid in 1..=sb.npages {\n            io.read_frame(pid as u64, &mut buf)?;\n            let frame = Frame::decode(&buf)?;\n            pages.insert(pid, frame);\n        }\n        Ok(Store {\n            inner: Mutex::new(Inner { io, sb, pages }),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// 打开后端；超级块不存在（空内存后端）时创建，否则按现有镜像打开。\n    ///\n    /// 对文件后端请显式使用 [`Store::create`] / [`Store::open`] 以免歧义。\n    pub fn create_or_open(io: Arc<dyn StorageIo>) -> Result<Self> {\n        let mut buf = vec![0u8; PAGE_SIZE];\n        match io.read_frame(0, &mut buf) {\n            Ok(()) => Self::open(io),\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof => Self::create(io),\n            Err(e) => Err(e.into()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn validate(data: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        if data.is_empty() {\n            return Err(Error::EmptyRecord);\n        }\n        if data.len() > MAX_RECORD {\n            return Err(Error::RecordTooLarge {\n                size: data.len(),\n                max: MAX_RECORD,\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// 写入一条可变长记录，返回其句柄（线性格式见 [`Handle::encode`]）。\n    pub fn put(&self, data: &[u8]) -> Result<String> {\n        Self::validate(data)?;\n        let mut g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n\n        // 跨页最佳适应：在能容纳的页中选剩余碎片最小者。\n        let mut best: Option<(u32, u32)> = None; // (page, slack)\n        for (&pid, frame) in &g.pages {\n            if let Some(slack) = frame.fit_score(data.len() as u32) {\n                best = Some(match best {\n                    Some((_, cur_slack)) if cur_slack <= slack => best.unwrap(),\n                    _ => (pid, slack),\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        let pid = match best {\n            Some((pid, _)) => pid,\n            None => g.alloc_new_page()?,\n        };\n\n        // 先在克隆上修改并写盘，成功后再替换内存镜像——写失败不留半成品。\n        let frame = g.pages.get(&pid).cloned().expect(\"page exists\");\n        let mut next = frame;\n        let (slot, gen) = next\n            .alloc(data)\n            .expect(\"fit_score said it would fit\");\n        g.io.write_frame(pid as u64, &next.encode())?;\n        g.pages.insert(pid, next);\n        Ok(Handle {\n            page: pid,\n            slot,\n            gen,\n        }\n        .encode())\n    }\n\n    /// 按句柄读取记录。\n    pub fn get(&self, handle: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        let h = Handle::parse(handle)?;\n        let g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        let frame = g\n            .pages\n            .get(&h.page)\n            .ok_or(Error::PageNotFound(h.page))?;\n        Ok(frame.get(h.slot, h.gen)?.to_vec())\n    }\n\n    /// 按句柄释放记录（幂等性刻意不提供：重复释放明确报错）。\n    pub fn free(&self, handle: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        let h = Handle::parse(handle)?;\n        let mut g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        let frame = g\n            .pages\n            .get(&h.page)\n            .ok_or(Error::PageNotFound(h.page))?\n            .clone();\n        let mut next = frame;\n        next.free_slot(h.slot, h.gen)?;\n        g.io.write_frame(h.page as u64, &next.encode())?;\n        g.pages.insert(h.page, next);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// 压缩指定页；存活句柄（页/槽/代次）语义全部保持。\n    pub fn compact_page(&self, page: u32) -> Result<bool> {\n        let mut g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        if !g.pages.contains_key(&page) {\n            return Err(Error::PageNotFound(page));\n        }\n        let frame = g.pages[&page].clone();\n        let mut next = frame;\n        let moved = next.compact();\n        g.io.write_frame(page as u64, &next.encode())?;\n        g.pages.insert(page, next);\n        Ok(moved)\n    }\n\n    /// 显式持久性边界：fsync 底层文件。\n    pub fn sync(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        let g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        Ok(g.io.sync()?)\n    }\n\n    /// 全局状态。\n    pub fn status(&self) -> Status {\n        let g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        let (live_records, used_bytes) = g\n            .pages\n            .values()\n            .map(|f| (f.live_count(), f.used_bytes()))\n            .fold((0usize, 0usize), |(l, u), (a, b)| (l + a, u + b));\n        Status {\n            npages: g.sb.npages,\n            live_records,\n            used_bytes,\n            max_records: MAX_RECORD,\n            page_size: PAGE_SIZE,\n            data_bytes_per_page: MAX_RECORD,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 单页布局（校验用）。\n    pub fn page_info(&self, page: u32) -> Result<PageInfo> {\n        let g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        let f = g.pages.get(&page).ok_or(Error::PageNotFound(page))?;\n        Ok(PageInfo {\n            page,\n            nslots: f.slots.len(),\n            live: f.live_count(),\n            used_bytes: f.used_bytes(),\n            free_start: f.free_start,\n            free_intervals: f.free_intervals(),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// 全部页的布局（校验用）。\n    pub fn all_page_infos(&self) -> Vec<PageInfo> {\n        let g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        g.pages\n            .keys()\n            .map(|p| {\n                let f = &g.pages[p];\n                PageInfo {\n                    page: *p,\n                    nslots: f.slots.len(),\n                    live: f.live_count(),\n                    used_bytes: f.used_bytes(),\n                    free_start: f.free_start,\n                    free_intervals: f.free_intervals(),\n                }\n            })\n            .collect()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Inner {\n    /// 分配新数据页：写帧成功后再提升超级块。\n    fn alloc_new_page(&mut self) -> Result<u32> {\n        let new_id = self\n            .sb\n            .npages\n            .checked_add(1)\n            .ok_or(Error::StorageFull)?;\n        let mut frame = Frame::new(new_id);\n        // 空页无需写内容，直接保留；调用方随后会在其上分配并写帧。\n        // 这里不写盘，由调用方统一完成“页帧 + 超级块”两次写。\n        // （保留 BTreeMap 插入到超级块写成功之后。）\n        let _ = &mut frame;\n        Ok(new_id)\n    }\n}\n\n// 上面的 alloc_new_page 需要与 put 的写流程配合，这里改为内聚实现。\nimpl Inner {\n    #[allow(dead_code)]\n    fn unused() {}\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_88356dda4ca9d8bbcc1cfa83","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":3361,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":52024,"output_tokens":3559,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_yg3ppfdv5w08lq3dwyd8xs3u":{"content":"//! [`Frame`]“先在克隆上修改、写成功后替换”的做法）。但普通 write 只把数据\n//! 交给操作系统页缓存，掉电可能丢失；只有显式调用 [`Store::sync`]\n//! （HTTP `POST /sync`）才执行底层 fsync，获得崩溃持久性保证。\n//!\n//! 新页分配的写入顺序为：**先写新页帧，再写超级块提升 npages**。这样超级块\n//! 引用到的页帧必然已写入；若超级块写失败，新帧只会成为不可达的孤儿帧，\n//! 不会出现“引用了半初始化页”的情况。\n\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse crate::disk::{SuperBlock, MAX_RECORD, PAGE_SIZE};\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::io::StorageIo;\nuse crate::page::{Frame, Handle};\n\n/// 线程安全的存储管理器。\npub struct Store {\n    inner: Mutex<Inner>,\n}\n\nstruct Inner {\n    io: Arc<dyn StorageIo>,\n    sb: SuperBlock,\n    pages: BTreeMap<u32, Frame>,\n}\n\n/// 单页布局信息（供 HTTP 检查接口与参考模型校验使用）。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct PageInfo {\n    pub page: u32,\n    pub nslots: usize,\n    pub live: usize,\n    pub used_bytes: usize,\n    pub free_start: u16,\n    /// 空闲区间（已合并），元素为 `[start,end)`。\n    pub free_intervals: Vec<(u32, u32)>,\n}\n\n/// 全局状态快照。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct Status {\n    pub npages: u32,\n    pub live_records: usize,\n    pub used_bytes: usize,\n    pub max_records: usize,\n    pub page_size: usize,\n    pub data_bytes_per_page: usize,\n}\n\nimpl Store {\n    /// 在全新（空）后端上创建存储，写入初始超级块。\n    pub fn create(io: Arc<dyn StorageIo>) -> Result<Self> {\n        let sb = SuperBlock { npages: 0 };\n        io.write_frame(0, &sb.encode())?;\n        Ok(Store {\n            inner: Mutex::new(Inner {\n                io,\n                sb,\n                pages: BTreeMap::new(),\n            }),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// 打开已有后端：读取超级块并急加载全部数据页（含 CRC 校验）。\n    pub fn open(io: Arc<dyn StorageIo>) -> Result<Self> {\n        let mut buf = vec![0u8; PAGE_SIZE];\n        io.read_frame(0, &mut buf)?;\n        let sb = SuperBlock::decode(&buf)?;\n        let mut pages = BTreeMap::new();\n        for pid in 1..=sb.npages {\n            io.read_frame(pid as u64, &mut buf)?;\n            let frame = Frame::decode(&buf)?;\n            pages.insert(pid, frame);\n        }\n        Ok(Store {\n            inner: Mutex::new(Inner { io, sb, pages }),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// 打开后端；超级块不存在（空内存后端）时创建，否则按现有镜像打开。\n    ///\n    /// 对文件后端请显式使用 [`Store::create`] / [`Store::open`] 以免歧义。\n    pub fn create_or_open(io: Arc<dyn StorageIo>) -> Result<Self> {\n        let mut buf = vec![0u8; PAGE_SIZE];\n        match io.read_frame(0, &mut buf) {\n            Ok(()) => Self::open(io),\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof => Self::create(io),\n            Err(e) => Err(e.into()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn validate(data: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        if data.is_empty() {\n            return Err(Error::EmptyRecord);\n        }\n        if data.len() > MAX_RECORD {\n            return Err(Error::RecordTooLarge {\n                size: data.len(),\n                max: MAX_RECORD,\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// 写入一条可变长记录，返回其句柄（线性格式见 [`Handle::encode`]）。\n    pub fn put(&self, data: &[u8]) -> Result<String> {\n        Self::validate(data)?;\n        let mut g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n\n        // 跨页最佳适应：在能容纳的页中选剩余碎片最小者。\n        let mut best: Option<(u32, u32)> = None; // (page, slack)\n        for (&pid, frame) in &g.pages {\n            if let Some(slack) = frame.fit_score(data.len() as u32) {\n                best = Some(match best {\n                    Some((_, cur_slack)) if cur_slack <= slack => best.unwrap(),\n                    _ => (pid, slack),\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        let pid = match best {\n            Some((pid, _)) => pid,\n            None => g.alloc_new_page()?,\n        };\n\n        // 先在克隆上修改并写盘，成功后再替换内存镜像——写失败不留半成品。\n        let frame = g.pages.get(&pid).cloned().expect(\"page exists\");\n        let mut next = frame;\n        let (slot, gen) = next\n            .alloc(data)\n            .expect(\"fit_score said it would fit\");\n        g.io.write_frame(pid as u64, &next.encode())?;\n        g.pages.insert(pid, next);\n        Ok(Handle {\n            page: pid,\n            slot,\n            gen,\n        }\n Frame::decode(&buf)?;\n            pages.insert(pid, frame);\n        }\n        Ok(Store {\n            inner: Mutex::new(Inner { io, sb, pages }),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// vec![0u8; PAGE_SIZE];\n        match io.read_frame(0, &mut buf) {\n            Ok(()) => Self::open(io),\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof => Self::create(io),\n {"parentUuid":"68789d75-3dc7-4a48-84ec-af041bc0486a","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_3ed16vakzq2yiqy3cuzjeu1w","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/a/src/http.rs","content":"//! 本地 HTTP 验证入口（纯标准库实现，无第三方依赖）。\n//!\n//! | 方法 路径                       | 含义                                   |\n//! |---------------------------------|----------------------------------------|\n//! | `POST /records`                 | 写入记录，请求体即原始字节，返回句柄    |\n//! | `GET  /records/{id}`            | 读取记录（原始字节返回，`application/octet-stream`） |\n//! | `DELETE /records/{id}`          | 释放记录；重复释放/旧句柄返回 409/410   |\n//! | `POST /pages/{page}/compact`    | 压缩指定页                              |\n//! | `GET  /pages`                   | 全部页布局（空闲区间、占用量）          |\n//! | `GET  /pages/{page}`            | 单页布局                                |\n//! | `GET  /status`                  | 全局状态                                |\n//! | `POST /sync`                    | 显式 fsync 持久性边界                   |\n//! | `POST /debug/fault`             | 设置故障注入计划（query 参数，见下）    |\n//!\n//! 故障计划参数（均可选，0/缺省表示清除）：\n//! `fail_write=<N>`、`torn_write=<N>`、`fail_sync=<N>`、`fail_read=<N>`，\n//! N 表示“第 N 次对应调用时注入”。\n//!\n//! 每个连接只处理一个请求后关闭（`Connection: close`），便于 `curl` 与\n//! 测试脚本逐请求验证。\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nuse crate::error::Error;\nuse crate::io::FaultPlan;\nuse crate::store::Store;\n\n/// HTTP 服务端。\npub struct Server {\n    store: Arc<Store>,\n    fault_plan: Option<Arc<Mutex<FaultPlan>>>,\n}\n\nimpl Server {\n    /// 无故障注入能力的服务（真实文件后端入口）。\n    pub fn new(store: Arc<Store>) -> Self {\n        Server {\n            store,\n            fault_plan: None,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 带故障注入控制端点的服务（测试入口）。\n    pub fn with_faults(store: Arc<Store>, fault_plan: Arc<Mutex<FaultPlan>>) -> Self {\n        Server {\n            store,\n            fault_plan: Some(fault_plan),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 绑定并开始服务，阻塞直到出错。\n    pub fn run(&self, addr: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n        let listener = TcpListener::bind(addr)?;\n        let actual = listener.local_addr()?;\n        eprintln!(\"pfs-server listening on http://{actual}\");\n        for stream in listener.incoming() {\n            match stream {\n                Ok(stream) => {\n                    let server = Server {\n                        store: Arc::clone(&self.store),\n                        fault_plan: self.fault_plan.as_ref().map(Arc::clone),\n                    };\n                    std::thread::spawn(move || {\n                        let _ = server.handle(stream);\n                    });\n                }\n                Err(e) => eprintln!(\"accept error: {e}\"),\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn handle(&self, mut stream: TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n        let _ = stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(10)));\n        let mut req = match read_request(&mut stream) {\n            Ok(r) => r,\n            Err(e) => {\n                eprintln!(\"bad request: {e}\");\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n        };\n        let resp = self.route(&mut req);\n        stream.write_all(&resp)?;\n        stream.flush()\n    }\n\n    fn route(&self, req: &mut Request) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let path = req.path.as_str();\n        match (req.method.as_str(), path) {\n            (\"GET\", \"/status\") => self.status(),\n            (\"GET\", \"/pages\") => self.pages(),\n            (\"POST\", \"/sync\") => self.sync(),\n            (\"POST\", \"/records\") => self.put_record(req),\n            (\"POST\", \"/debug/fault\") => self.set_fault(req),\n            (\"GET\", p) if let Some(id) = prefix_record(p) => self.get_record(&id),\n            (\"DELETE\", p) if let Some(id) = prefix_record(p) => self.delete_record(&id),\n            (\"GET\", p) if let Some(page) = prefix_page(p) => self.page(&page),\n            (\"POST\", p) if let Some(page) = prefix_compact(p) => self.compact(&page),\n            _ => response(404, \"application/json\", b\"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"not found\\\"}\"),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn put_record(&self, req: &Request) -> Vec<u8> {\n        match self.store.put(&req.body) {\n            Ok(id) => {\n                let json = format!(\"{{\\\"id\\\":{}}}\", json_str(&id));\n                response(201, \"application/json\", json.as_bytes())\n            }\n            Err(e) => err_response(&e),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn get_record(&self, id: &str) -> Vec<u8> {\n        match self.store.get(id) {\n            Ok(data) => response(200, \"application/octet-stream\", &data),\n            Err(e) => err_response(&e),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn delete_record(&self, id: &str) -> Vec<u8> {\n        match self.store.free(id) {\n            Ok(()) => response(200, \"application/json\", b\"{\\\"freed\\\":true}\"),\n            Err(e) => err_response(&e),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn compact(&self, page: &str) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let page: u32 = match page.parse() {\n            Ok(p) => p,\n            Err(_) => return response(400, \"application/json\", b\"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"bad page id\\\"}\"),\n        };\n        match self.store.compact_page(page) {\n            Ok(moved) => {\n                let json = format!(\"{{\\\"page\\\":{page},\\\"moved\\\":{moved}}}\");\n                response(200, \"application/json\", json.as_bytes())\n            }\n            Err(e) => err_response(&e),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn page(&self, page: &str) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let page: u32 = match page.parse() {\n            Ok(p) => p,\n            Err(_) => return response(400, \"application/json\", b\"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"bad page id\\\"}\"),\n        };\n        match self.store.page_info(page) {\n            Ok(info) => response(200, \"application/json\", page_json(&info).into_bytes()),\n            Err(e) => err_response(&e),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn pages(&self) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let infos = self.store.all_page_infos();\n        let mut out = String::from(\"[\");\n        for (i, info) in infos.iter().enumerate() {\n            if i > 0 {\n                out.push(',');\n            }\n            out.push_str(&page_json(info));\n        }\n        out.push(']');\n        response(200, \"application/json\", out.as_bytes())\n    }\n\n    fn status(&self) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let s = self.store.status();\n        let json = format!(\n            \"{{\\\"npages\\\":{},\\\"live_records\\\":{},\\\"used_bytes\\\":{},\\\"page_size\\\":{},\\\"data_bytes_per_page\\\":{},\\\"max_record\\\":{}}}\",\n            s.npages, s.live_records, s.used_bytes, s.page_size, s.data_bytes_per_page, s.max_records\n        );\n        response(200, \"application/json\", json.as_bytes())\n    }\n\n    fn sync(&self) -> Vec<u8> {\n        match self.store.sync() {\n            Ok(()) => response(200, \"application/json\", b\"{\\\"synced\\\":true}\"),\n            Err(e) => err_response(&e),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn set_fault(&self, req: &Request) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let Some(plan) = &self.fault_plan else {\n            return response(\n                403,\n                \"application/json\",\n                b\"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"fault injection not enabled on this server\\\"}\",\n            );\n        };\n        let q = match req.query.as_deref() {\n            Some(q) => q,\n            None => \"\",\n        };\n        let mut next = FaultPlan::default();\n        for (k, v) in form_urlencoded(q) {\n            let n: u64 = match v.parse() {\n                Ok(0) | Err(_) => continue,\n                Ok(n) => n,\n            };\n            match k.as_str() {\n                \"fail_write\" => next.fail_write_at = Some(n),\n                \"torn_write\" => next.torn_write_at = Some(n),\n                \"fail_sync\" => next.fail_sync_at = Some(n),\n                \"fail_read\" => next.fail_read_at = Some(n),\n                _ => {}\n            }\n        }\n        *plan.lock().unwrap() = next.clone();\n        let json = format!(\n            \"{{\\\"fail_write_at\\\":{},\\\"torn_write_at\\\":{},\\\"fail_sync_at\\\":{},\\\"fail_read_at\\\":{}}}\",\n            opt(next.fail_write_at),\n            opt(next.torn_write_at),\n            opt(next.fail_sync_at),\n            opt(next.fail_read_at)\n        );\n        response(200, \"application/json\", json.as_bytes())\n    }\n}\n\nfn opt(v: Option<u64>) -> String {\n    match v {\n        Some(n) => n.to_string(),\n        None => \"null\".to_string(),\n    }\n}\n\nfn prefix_record(path: &str) -> Option<String> {\n    path.strip_prefix(\"/records/\")\n        .map(|s| s.to_string())\n        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty() && !s.contains('/'))\n}\n\nfn prefix_page(path: &str) -> Option<String> {\n    path.strip_prefix(\"/pages/\")\n        .map(|s| s.to_string())\n        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty() && !s.contains('/'))\n}\n\nfn prefix_compact(path: &str) -> Option<String> {\n    path.strip_prefix(\"/pages/\")\n        .and_then(|s| s.strip_suffix(\"/compact\"))\n        .map(|s| s.to_string())\n        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty() && !s.contains('/'))\n}\n\nfn page_json(info: &crate::store::PageInfo) -> String {\n    let intervals = info\n        .free_intervals\n        .iter()\n        .map(|(a, b)| format!(\"[{a},{b}]\"))\n        .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n        .join(\",\");\n    format!(\n        \"{{\\\"page\\\":{},\\\"nslots\\\":{},\\\"live\\\":{},\\\"used_bytes\\\":{},\\\"free_start\\\":{},\\\"free_intervals\\\":[{}]}}\",\n        info.page, info.nslots, info.live, info.used_bytes, info.free_start, intervals\n    )\n}\n\nfn err_response(e: &Error) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let (status, kind) = match e {\n        Error::Io(_) => (500, \"io_error\"),\n        Error::EmptyRecord | Error::RecordTooLarge { .. } | Error::BadHandle(_) => {\n            (400, \"bad_request\")\n        }\n        Error::StorageFull => (507, \"storage_full\"),\n        Error::PageNotFound(_) | Error::SlotNotFound(_, _) => (404, \"not_found\"),\n        Error::AlreadyFreed { .. } => (409, \"already_freed\"),\n        Error::StaleHandle { .. } => (410, \"stale_handle\"),\n        Error::Corrupt(_) => (500, \"corrupt_image\"),\n    };\n    let body = format!(\"{{\\\"error\\\":{},\\\"kind\\\":\\\"{kind}\\\"}}\", json_str(&e.to_string()));\n    response(status, \"application/json\", body.as_bytes())\n}\n\nfn response(status: u16, content_type: &str, body: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let reason = match status {\n        200 => \"OK\",\n        201 => \"Created\",\n        400 => \"Bad Request\",\n        403 => \"Forbidden\",\n        404 => \"Not Found\",\n        409 => \"Conflict\",\n        410 => \"Gone\",\n        500 => \"Internal Server Error\",\n        507 => \"Insufficient Storage\",\n        _ => \"OK\",\n    };\n    let mut head = format!(\n        \"HTTP/1.1 {status} {reason}\\r\\n\\\n         Content-Type: {content_type}\\r\\n\\\n         Content-Length: {}\\r\\n\\\n         Connection: close\\r\\n\\\n         \\r\\n\",\n        body.len()\n    );\n    head.as_bytes().iter().chain(body).copied().collect()\n}\n\n/// JSON 字符串转义（最少必要字符集）。\nfn json_str(s: &str) -> String {\n    let mut out = String::with_capacity(s.len() + 2);\n    out.push('\"');\n    for c in s.chars() {\n        match c {\n            '\"' => out.push_str(\"\\\\\\\"\"),\n            '\\\\' => out.push_str(\"\\\\\\\\\"),\n            '\\n' => out.push_str(\"\\\\n\"),\n            '\\r' => out.push_str(\"\\\\r\"),\n            '\\t' => out.push_str(\"\\\\t\"),\n            c if (c as u32) < 0x20 => out.push_str(&format!(\"\\\\u{:04x}\", c as u32)),\n            c => out.push(c),\n        }\n    }\n    out.push('\"');\n    out\n}\n\nfn form_urlencoded(s: &str) -> Vec<(String, String)> {\n    s.split('&')\n        .filter(|kv| !kv.is_empty())\n        .filter_map(|kv| kv.split_once('='))\n        .map(|(k, v)| (percent_decode(k), percent_decode(v)))\n        .collect()\n}\n\nfn percent_decode(s: &str) -> String {\n    let bytes = s.as_bytes();\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(bytes.len());\n    let mut i = 0;\n    while i < bytes.len() {\n        if bytes[i] == b'%' && i + 2 < bytes.len() {\n            if let Ok(b) = u8::from_str_radix(&s[i + 1..i + 3], 16) {\n                out.push(b);\n                i += 3;\n                continue;\n            }\n        }\n        if bytes[i] == b'+' {\n            out.push(b' ');\n        } else {\n            out.push(bytes[i]);\n        }\n        i += 1;\n    }\n    String::from_utf8_lossy(&out).into_owned()\n}\n\n/// 已解析的 HTTP 请求。\npub struct Request {\n    method: String,\n    path: String,\n    query: Option<String>,\n    #[allow(dead_code)]\n    headers: Vec<(String, String)>,\n    body: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\nfn read_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<Request> {\n    // 读头部直到 \\r\\n\\r\\n。\n    let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(4096);\n    let mut byte = [0u8; 1];\n    let header_end;\n    loop {\n        if stream.read(&mut byte)? == 0 {\n            return Err(std::io::Error::new(\n                std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof,\n                \"connection closed before request completed\",\n            ));\n        }\n        buf.push(byte[0]);\n        if buf.len() >= 4 && &buf[buf.len() - 4..] == b\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\" {\n            header_end = buf.len();\n            break;\n        }\n        if buf.len() > 64 * 1024 {\n            return Err(std::io::Error::new(\n                std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                \"headers too large\",\n            ));\n        }\n    }\n    let head = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..header_end]).into_owned();\n    let mut lines = head.split(\"\\r\\n\");\n    let request_line = lines.next().unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let mut parts = request_line.split_whitespace();\n    let method = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\").to_string();\n    let raw_target = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let (path, query) = match raw_target.split_once('?') {\n        Some((p, q)) => (p.to_string(), Some(q.to_string())),\n        None => (raw_target.to_string(), None),\n    };\n    let mut headers = Vec::new();\n    let mut content_length = 0usize;\n    for line in lines {\n        if line.is_empty() {\n            continue;\n        }\n        if let Some((k, v)) = line.split_once(':') {\n            let k = k.trim().to_string();\n            let v = v.trim().to_string();\n            if k.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"content-length\") {\n                content_length = v.parse().unwrap_or(0);\n            }\n            headers.push((k, v));\n        }\n    }\n    if content_length > 16 * 1024 * 1024 {\n        return Err(std::io::Error::new(\n            std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n            \"body too large\",\n        ));\n    }\n    let mut body = vec![0u8; content_length];\n    // 头部和 body 之间没有粘包（一次一字节读取），body 需完整读取。\n    let mut read = 0;\n    while read < content_length {\n        let n = stream.read(&mut body[read..])?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            return Err(std::io::Error::new(\n                std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof,\n                \"truncated body\",\n            ));\n        }\n        read += n;\n    }\n    Ok(Request {\n        method,\n        path,\n        query,\n        headers,\n        body,\n    })\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_8534944f164853f5eb910495","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1347,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":60216,"output_tokens":4632,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_3ed16vakzq2yiqy3cuzjeu1w":{"content":"//! \"{{\\\"npages\\\":{},\\\"live_records\\\":{},\\\"used_bytes\\\":{},\\\"page_size\\\":{},\\\"data_bytes_per_page\\\":{},\\\"max_record\\\":{}}}\",\n            s.npages, s.live_records, s.used_bytes, `--faults`：启用 `/debug/fault` 故障注入控制端点（仅建议本地验证使用）。\n\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::ExitCode;\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse pfs::http::Server;\nuse pfs::io::{FaultPlan, FaultyStorage, FileStorage};\nuse pfs::store::Store;\n\nstruct Args {\n    file: Option<PathBuf>,\n    addr: String,\n    new_store: bool,\n    faults: bool,\n}\n\nfn parse_args() -> Args {\n    let {"parentUuid":"7041c1b8-b491-42c3-b9c9-580b21d6eaa8","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_q6k6glgfi7ys47lzgdesr76z","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/a/src/page.rs","old_string":"    #[test]\n    fn alloc_free_split_merge_reuse() {\n        let mut pg = Frame::new(0);\n        let h1 = pg.alloc(b\"aaaa\").unwrap();\n        let h2 = pg.alloc(b\"bbbbbb\").unwrap();\n        let h3 = pg.alloc(b\"cc\").unwrap();\n        // 三个独立区间 + 低端中央区间 = 4 段空闲。\n        assert_eq!(pg.free_intervals().len(), 4);\n        // 释放中间记录：孔洞先出现，再被相邻释放合并。\n        pg.free_slot(h2.0, h2.1).unwrap();\n        assert!(pg\n            .free_intervals()\n            .iter()\n            .any(|(a, b)| b - a == 6));\n        pg.free_slot(h1.0, h1.1).unwrap();\n        // h1 与 h2 的孔洞相邻（h1 在更高地址），应合并为 10 字节区间。\n        assert!(pg\n            .free_intervals()\n            .iter()\n            .any(|(a, b)| b - a == 10), \"intervals: {:?}\", pg.free_intervals());\n        pg.free_slot(h3.0, h3.1).unwrap();\n        // 全部释放后只剩一个（中央）空闲区间。\n        assert_eq!(pg.free_intervals().len(), 1);\n    }","new_string":"    #[test]\n    fn alloc_free_split_merge_reuse() {\n        let mut pg = Frame::new(0);\n        // 不同尺寸记录：4B 在页末高端，其下 6B，再下 2B，中间各有空洞。\n        let h1 = pg.alloc(b\"aaaa\").unwrap(); // 4B\n        let h2 = pg.alloc(b\"bbbbbb\").unwrap(); // 6B\n        let h3 = pg.alloc(b\"cc\").unwrap(); // 2B\n        // 三条记录互不相邻：记录间有两个空洞，再加低端中央空闲 = 3 段。\n        assert_eq!(pg.free_intervals().len(), 3, \"{:?}\", pg.free_intervals());\n        // 释放中间记录：6B 孔洞独立出现（分裂的逆过程）。\n        pg.free_slot(h2.0, h2.1).unwrap();\n        assert!(pg\n            .free_intervals()\n            .iter()\n            .any(|(a, b)| b - a == 6), \"{:?}\", pg.free_intervals());\n        // 释放高端的 4B：与 6B 孔洞相邻，应合并为 10 字节区间。\n        pg.free_slot(h1.0, h1.1).unwrap();\n        assert!(pg\n            .free_intervals()\n            .iter()\n            .any(|(a, b)| b - a == 10), \"intervals: {:?}\", pg.free_intervals());\n        // 释放最后的 2B：全部空闲合并为单一区间（与槽区前沿相接）。\n        pg.free_slot(h3.0, h3.1).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(pg.free_intervals().len(), 1);\n        assert_eq!(\n            pg.free_intervals()[0],\n            (slot_front_for_tests(&pg), DATA_END as u32)\n        );\n\n        // 合并后的空间必须立即可再分配：墓碑槽被复用、代次递增。\n        let (s4, g4) = pg.alloc(b\"dddd\").unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(s4, h1.0);\n        assert_ne!(g4, h1.1);\n    }"},"name":"Edit","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_b9697f726889b88b145d969c","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1005,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":70456,"output_tokens":1001,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_q6k6glgfi7ys47lzgdesr76z":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/a/src/page.rs","new_string":"    #[test]\n    fn alloc_free_split_merge_reuse() {\n        let mut pg = Frame::new(0);\n        // 不同尺寸记录：4B 在页末高端，其下 6B，再下 2B，中间各有空洞。\n        let h1 = pg.alloc(b\"aaaa\").unwrap(); // 4B\n        let h2 = pg.alloc(b\"bbbbbb\").unwrap(); // 6B\n        let h3 = pg.alloc(b\"cc\").unwrap(); // 2B\n        // 三条记录互不相邻：记录间有两个空洞，再加低端中央空闲 = 3 段。\n        assert_eq!(pg.free_intervals().len(), 3, \"{:?}\", pg.free_intervals());\n        // 释放中间记录：6B 孔洞独立出现（分裂的逆过程）。\n        pg.free_slot(h2.0, h2.1).unwrap();\n        assert!(pg\n            .free_intervals()\n            .iter()\n            .any(|(a, b)| b - {"parentUuid":"5c132ee7-32ad-416f-a825-fe62a7f9d855","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_mm6qxmnlh46riy5b4r6p7wlw","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/a/src/page.rs","old_string":"    #[test]\n    fn alloc_free_split_merge_reuse() {\n        let mut pg = Frame::new(0);\n        // 不同尺寸记录：4B 在页末高端，其下 6B，再下 2B，中间各有空洞。\n        let h1 = pg.alloc(b\"aaaa\").unwrap(); // 4B\n        let h2 = pg.alloc(b\"bbbbbb\").unwrap(); // 6B\n        let h3 = pg.alloc(b\"cc\").unwrap(); // 2B\n        // 三条记录互不相邻：记录间有两个空洞，再加低端中央空闲 = 3 段。\n        assert_eq!(pg.free_intervals().len(), 3, \"{:?}\", pg.free_intervals());\n        // 释放中间记录：6B 孔洞独立出现（分裂的逆过程）。\n        pg.free_slot(h2.0, h2.1).unwrap();\n        assert!(pg\n            .free_intervals()\n            .iter()\n            .any(|(a, b)| b - a == 6), \"{:?}\", pg.free_intervals());\n\n        // 释放高端 4B：与 6B 孔洞相邻，合并为 10B 区间。\n        pg.free_slot(h1.0, h1.1).unwrap();\n        assert!(pg\n            .free_intervals()\n            .iter()\n            .any(|(a, b)| b - a == 10), \"intervals: {:?}\", pg.free_intervals());\n\n        // 释放最后的 2B：全部空闲合并为单一区间，低端与槽区前沿相接。\n        pg.free_slot(h3.0, h3.1).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(pg.free_intervals().len(), 1);\n        assert_eq!(\n            pg.free_intervals()[0],\n            (slot_front_for_tests(&pg), DATA_END as u32)\n        );\n\n        // 合并后的空间必须立即可再分配：墓碑槽被复用、代次递增。\n        let (s4, g4) = pg.alloc(b\"dddd\").unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(s4, h1.0);\n        assert_ne!(g4, h1.1);\n    }"},"name":"Edit","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_b4470772a5f2afdede9b41f3","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2002,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":70456,"output_tokens":1352,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_mm6qxmnlh46riy5b4r6p7wlw":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/a/src/page.rs","new_string":"    #[test]\n    fn alloc_free_split_merge_reuse() {\n        let mut pg = Frame::new(0);\n        // 三条记录紧邻页末依次摆放：4B | 6B | 2B，之间无空隙，\n        // 所以初始空闲只有低端中央区间 1 段。\n        let h1 = pg.alloc(b\"aaaa\").unwrap(); // 4092..4096\n        let h2 = pg.alloc(b\"bbbbbb\").unwrap(); // 4086..4092\n        let h3 = pg.alloc(b\"cc\").unwrap(); // 4084..4086\n        assert_eq!(pg.free_intervals().len(), 1);\n\n        // 释放中间记录：区间被“分裂”出一个 6B 孔洞，共 2 段。\n        pg.free_slot(h2.0, h2.1).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(pg.free_intervals().len(), 2);\n        assert!(pg\n            .free_intervals()\n            .iter()\n            .any(|(a, b)| b - {"parentUuid":"cb94c7dd-40ea-40a3-95f5-e9cfd6a636f4","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_s6tzkvo2nfljl5yhu0otaaqg","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/a/tests/common/mod.rs","content":"//! 测试公共辅助：内存存储构造、HTTP 客户端、不变量检查。\n#![allow(dead_code)]\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::TcpStream;\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nuse pfs::io::{FaultPlan, FaultyStorage, MemStorage, StorageIo};\nuse pfs::store::Store;\n\n/// 创建基于纯内存后端的存储。\npub fn mem_store() -> Arc<Store> {\n    let io: Arc<dyn StorageIo> = Arc::new(MemStorage::new());\n    Arc::new(Store::create(io).unwrap())\n}\n\n/// 创建“内存后端 + 故障注入包装”的存储与可共享故障计划。\npub fn faulty_mem_store() -> (Arc<Store>, Arc<Mutex<FaultPlan>>, Arc<FaultyStorage<MemStorage>>) {\n    let mem =
