I/O 错误，或把某次写变成只落半页的**撕裂写**。\n\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::fs::{File, OpenOptions};\nuse std::io;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse std::os::unix::fs::FileExt;\n\nuse crate::disk::PAGE_SIZE;\n\n/// 帧存储抽象。`frame_no` 即帧号（0 为超级块，页号 = 数据页帧号）。\npub trait StorageIo: Send + Sync {\n    /// 将恰好一帧读入 `buf`（长度必须为 [`PAGE_SIZE`]）；越过文件尾返回 EOF 错误。\n    fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 将一帧写入指定帧号（部分长度也允许，用于模拟撕裂写）。\n    fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 强制把已写入的数据刷到物理介质。\n    fn sync(&self) -> io::Result<()>;\n}\n\nimpl<S: StorageIo + ?Sized> StorageIo for Box<S> {\n    fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        (**self).read_frame(frame_no, buf)\n    }\n    fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        (**self).write_frame(frame_no, data)\n    }\n    fn sync(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        (**self).sync()\n    }\n}\n\n/// 真实文件后端。\npub struct FileStorage {\n    file: File,\n}\n\nimpl FileStorage {\n    /// 创建全新的空存储文件（要求路径不存在）。\n    pub fn create(path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> io::Result<Self> {\n        if let Some(parent) = path.as_ref().parent() {\n            if !parent.as_os_str().is_empty() {\n                std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;\n            }\n        }\n        let file = OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .create_new(true)\n            .open(path)?;\n        Ok(FileStorage { file })\n    }\n\n    /// 打开已有存储文件。\n    pub fn open(path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> io::Result<Self> {\n        let file = OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .open(path)?;\n        Ok(FileStorage { file })\n    }\n}\n\nimpl StorageIo for FileStorage {\n    fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        debug_assert_eq!(buf.len(), PAGE_SIZE);\n        let off = frame_no * PAGE_SIZE as u64;\n        let n = self.file.read_at(buf, off)?;\n        if n != buf.len() {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(\n                io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof,\n                format!(\"short read at frame {frame_no}: {n}/{PAGE_SIZE} bytes\"),\n            ));\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        debug_assert!(data.len() <= PAGE_SIZE);\n        let off = frame_no * PAGE_SIZE as u64;\n        self.file.write_all_at(data, off)\n    }\n\n    fn sync(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.file.sync_all()\n    }\n}\n\n/// 纯内存后端：帧号 -> 字节。写半帧会真的只存半帧，因此撕裂写可被 CRC 检出。\n#[derive(Default)]\npub struct MemStorage {\n    frames: Mutex<HashMap<u64, Vec<u8>>>,\n    sync_count: Mutex<u64>,\n}\n\nimpl MemStorage {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        Self::default()\n    }\n\n    pub fn sync_count(&self) -> u64 {\n        *self.sync_count.lock().unwrap()\n    }\n\n    /// 快照（帧号排序），供测试检查磁盘镜像。\n    pub fn snapshot(&self) -> Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)> {\n        let frames = self.frames.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut v: Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)> =\n            frames.iter().map(|(k, v)| (*k, v.clone())).collect();\n        v.sort_by_key(|(k, _)| *k);\n        v\n    }\n}\n\nimpl StorageIo for MemStorage {\n    fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        debug_assert_eq!(buf.len(), PAGE_SIZE);\n        let frames = self.frames.lock().unwrap();\n        let frame = frames.get(&frame_no).ok_or_else(|| {\n            io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof, format!(\"no frame {frame_no}\"))\n        })?;\n 验收测试：区间参考模型。\n//!\n//! 对同一个工作负载同时驱动：\n//! - **被测系统**：`Store`（内部是槽位页 + 空闲区间分配器）；\n//! - **参考模型**：句柄 -> (payload) 的逻辑映射，外加从磁盘字节独立解析出的\n//!   存活记录区间集合。\n//!\n//! 每个操作后检查四类不变量：\n//! 1. **无重叠**：所有页存活记录区间两两不相交；\n//! 2. **区间一致**：页头/slot 表声明的区间与参考模型完全一致；\n//! 3. **空间守恒**：`槽区 + used + 空闲长度 = 每页常量`，且全局 used\n//!    等于参考模型中存活记录字节总和；\n//! 4. **内容一致**：按句柄读回的字节与模型一致；旧句柄读/释放必然失败。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};\n\nuse pfs::disk::{DATA_END, DATA_START, MAX_RECORD, PAGE_HEADER_SIZE, PAGE_SIZE, SLOT_ENTRY_SIZE};\nuse pfs::page::Handle;\nuse pfs::store::Store;\n\n#[path = \"common/mod.rs\"]\n#[allow(unused)]\nmod c;\n\nuse common::{faulty_mem_store, mem_store};\n\n/// 确定性 xorshift64* RNG，避免任何外部依赖。\nstruct Rng(u64);\nimpl Rng {\n    fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {\n        let mut x = self.0;\n        x ^= x >> 12;\n        x ^= x << 25;\n        x ^= x >> 27;\n        self.0 = x;\n        x.wrapping_mul(0x2545_F491_4F6C_DD1D)\n [`Frame`]“先在克隆上修改、写成功后替换”的做法）。但普通 write 只把数据\n//! 交给操作系统页缓存，掉电可能丢失；只有显式调用 [`Store::sync`]\n//! （HTTP `POST /sync`）才执行底层 fsync，获得崩溃持久性保证。\n//!\n//! 新页分配的写入顺序为：**先写新页帧，再写超级块提升 npages**。这样超级块\n//! 引用到的页帧必然已写入；若超级块写失败，新帧只会成为不可达的孤儿帧，\n//! 不会出现“引用了半初始化页”的情况。\n\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse crate::disk::{SuperBlock, MAX_RECORD, PAGE_SIZE};\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::io::StorageIo;\nuse crate::page::{Frame, Handle};\n\n/// 线程安全的存储管理器。\npub struct Store {\n    inner: Mutex<Inner>,\n}\n\nstruct Inner {\n    io: Arc<dyn StorageIo>,\n    sb: SuperBlock,\n    pages: BTreeMap<u32, Frame>,\n}\n\n/// 单页布局信息（供 HTTP 检查接口与参考模型校验使用）。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct PageInfo {\n    pub page: u32,\n    pub nslots: usize,\n    pub live: usize,\n    pub used_bytes: usize,\n    pub free_start: u16,\n    /// 空闲区间（已合并），元素为 `[start,end)`。\n    pub free_intervals: Vec<(u32, u32)>,\n}\n\n/// 全局状态快照。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct Status {\n    pub npages: u32,\n    pub live_records: usize,\n    pub used_bytes: usize,\n    pub max_records: usize,\n    pub page_size: usize,\n    pub data_bytes_per_page: usize,\n}\n\nimpl Store {\n    /// 在全新（空）后端上创建存储，写入初始超级块。\n    pub fn create(io: Arc<dyn StorageIo>) -> Result<Self> {\n        let sb = SuperBlock { npages: 0 };\n        io.write_frame(0, &sb.encode())?;\n        Ok(Store {\n            inner: Mutex::new(Inner {\n                io,\n                sb,\n                pages: BTreeMap::new(),\n            }),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// 打开已有后端：读取超级块并急加载全部数据页（含 CRC 校验）。\n    pub fn open(io: Arc<dyn StorageIo>) -> Result<Self> {\n        let mut buf = vec![0u8; PAGE_SIZE];\n        io.read_frame(0, &mut buf)?;\n        let sb = SuperBlock::decode(&buf)?;\n        let mut pages = BTreeMap::new();\n        for pid in 1..=sb.npages {\n            io.read_frame(pid as u64, &mut buf)?;\n            let frame = Frame::decode(&buf)?;\n            pages.insert(pid, frame);\n        }\n        Ok(Store {\n            inner: Mutex::new(Inner { io, sb, pages }),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// 打开后端；超级块不存在（空内存后端）时创建，否则按现有镜像打开。\n    ///\n    /// 对文件后端请显式使用 [`Store::create`] / [`Store::open`] 以免歧义。\n    pub fn create_or_open(io: Arc<dyn StorageIo>) -> Result<Self> {\n        let mut buf = vec![0u8; PAGE_SIZE];\n        match io.read_frame(0, &mut buf) {\n            Ok(()) => Self::open(io),\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof => Self::create(io),\n            Err(e) => Err(e.into()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn validate(data: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        if data.is_empty() {\n            return Err(Error::EmptyRecord);\n        }\n        if data.len() > MAX_RECORD {\n            return Err(Error::RecordTooLarge {\n                size: data.len(),\n                max: MAX_RECORD,\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// 写入一条可变长记录，返回其句柄（线性格式见 [`Handle::encode`]）。\n    pub fn put(&self, data: &[u8]) -> Result<String> {\n        Self::validate(data)?;\n        let mut g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n\n        // [`Frame`]“先在克隆上修改、写成功后替换”的做法）。但普通 write 只把数据\n//! 交给操作系统页缓存，掉电可能丢失；只有显式调用 [`Store::sync`]\n//! （HTTP `POST /sync`）才执行底层 fsync，获得崩溃持久性保证。\n//!\n//! 新页分配的写入顺序为：**先写新页帧，再写超级块提升 npages**。这样超级块\n//! 引用到的页帧必然已写入；若超级块写失败，新帧只会成为不可达的孤儿帧，\n//! 不会出现“引用了半初始化页”的情况。\n\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse crate::disk::{SuperBlock, MAX_RECORD, PAGE_SIZE};\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::io::StorageIo;\nuse crate::page::{Frame, Handle};\n\n/// 线程安全的存储管理器。\npub struct Store {\n    inner: Mutex<Inner>,\n}\n\nstruct Inner {\n    io: Arc<dyn StorageIo>,\n    sb: SuperBlock,\n    pages: BTreeMap<u32, Frame>,\n}\n\n/// 单页布局信息（供 HTTP 检查接口与参考模型校验使用）。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct PageInfo {\n    pub page: u32,\n    pub nslots: usize,\n    pub live: usize,\n    pub used_bytes: usize,\n    pub free_start: u16,\n    /// 存活槽明细：`(槽号, 偏移, 长度, 代次)`。\n    pub slots: Vec<(u16, u16, u16, u32)>,\n    /// 空闲区间（已合并），元素为 `[start,end)`。\n    pub free_intervals: Vec<(u32, u32)>,\n}\n\n/// 全局状态快照。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct Status {\n    pub npages: u32,\n    pub live_records: usize,\n    pub used_bytes: usize,\n    pub max_records: usize,\n    pub page_size: usize,\n    pub data_bytes_per_page: usize,\n}\n\nimpl Store {\n    /// 在全新（空）后端上创建存储，写入初始超级块。\n    pub fn create(io: Arc<dyn StorageIo>) -> Result<Self> {\n        let sb = SuperBlock { npages: 0 };\n        io.write_frame(0, &sb.encode())?;\n        Ok(Store {\n            inner: Mutex::new(Inner {\n                io,\n                sb,\n                pages: BTreeMap::new(),\n            }),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// 打开已有后端：读取超级块并急加载全部数据页（含 CRC 校验）。\n    pub fn open(io: Arc<dyn StorageIo>) -> Result<Self> {\n        let mut buf = vec![0u8; PAGE_SIZE];\n        io.read_frame(0, &mut buf)?;\n        let sb = SuperBlock::decode(&buf)?;\n        let mut pages = BTreeMap::new();\n        for pid in 1..=sb.npages {\n            io.read_frame(pid as u64, &mut buf)?;\n            let frame = Frame::decode(&buf)?;\n            pages.insert(pid, frame);\n        }\n        Ok(Store {\n            inner: Mutex::new(Inner { io, sb, pages }),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// 打开后端；超级块不存在（空内存后端）时创建，否则按现有镜像打开。\n    ///\n    /// 对文件后端请显式使用 [`Store::create`] / [`Store::open`] 以免歧义。\n    pub fn create_or_open(io: Arc<dyn StorageIo>) -> Result<Self> {\n        let mut buf = vec![0u8; PAGE_SIZE];\n        match io.read_frame(0, &mut buf) {\n            Ok(()) => Self::open(io),\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof => Self::create(io),\n            Err(e) => Err(e.into()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn validate(data: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        if data.is_empty() {\n {"parentUuid":"015f1402-8c43-4921-9a84-6f1b0e61badf","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_qkwbljar6gz9uowwqrjk7kx4","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/a/tests/reference_model.rs","content":"//! 验收测试：区间参考模型。\n//!\n//! 对同一个工作负载同时驱动：\n//! - **被测系统**：`Store`（槽位页 + 空闲区间分配器 + 代次句柄）；\n//! - **参考模型**：`句柄 -> (page,slot,gen,payload)` 的逻辑映射。\n//!\n//! 每个检查点验证四类不变量：\n//! 1. **无重叠**：每页存活记录区间两两不相交，且全部落在数据区\n//!    `[DATA_START, DATA_END)`；\n//! 2. **空间守恒**：每页 `header + nslots*8 + Σ记录长 + Σ空闲长 = PAGE_SIZE`；\n//!    全局 `Σ used` 等于参考模型存活字节总和；\n//! 3. **区间/集合一致**：页槽位表中的 `(slot, gen, len)` 集合与模型一致；\n//! 4. **句柄语义**：模型存活句柄读回内容一致；已释放句柄读/释放必失败；\n//!    旧代次句柄不可能读到复用槽位的新记录。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};\n\nuse pfs::disk::{DATA_END, DATA_START, PAGE_HEADER_SIZE, PAGE_SIZE, SLOT_ENTRY_SIZE};\nuse pfs::page::Handle;\nuse pfs::store::Store;\n\nuse common::mem_store;\n\n/// 确定性 xorshift RNG（无外部依赖）。\nstruct Rng(u64);\nimpl Rng {\n    fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {\n        let mut x = self.0;\n        x ^= x >> 12;\n        x ^= x << 25;\n        x ^= x >> 27;\n        self.0 = x;\n        x.wrapping_mul(0x2545_F491_4F6C_DD1D)\n    }\n    fn range(&mut self, n: u64) -> usize {\n        (self.next_u64() % n) as usize\n    }\n}\n\n/// 参考模型。\n#[derive(Default)]\nstruct Model {\n    /// 有效句柄 -> 记录内容（与系统内状态必须一致）。\n    live: BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>,\n    /// 已失效句柄集合：再读/再释放都必须失败。\n    dead: BTreeSet<String>,\n}\n\nimpl Model {\n    fn assert_invariants(&self, store: &Store) {\n        // 模型按页聚合期望槽位：(slot, gen, len)\n        let mut expected: BTreeMap<u32, BTreeSet<(u16, u32, u16)>> = BTreeMap::new();\n        let mut expected_bytes = 0usize;\n        for (id, payload) in &self.live {\n            let h = Handle::parse(id).expect(\"model ids parse\");\n            expected\n                .entry(h.page)\n                .or_default()\n                .insert((h.slot, h.gen, payload.len() as u16));\n            expected_bytes += payload.len();\n        }\n\n        let infos = store.all_page_infos();\n        let mut total_used = 0usize;\n\n        for info in &infos {\n            // ---------- 1. 无重叠（记录区间 + 空闲区间分别检查）----------\n            let mut occ: Vec<(u32, u32)> = info\n                .slots\n                .iter()\n                .map(|(_, off, len, _)| (u32::from(*off), u32::from(*off) + u32::from(*len)))\n                .collect();\n            occ.sort_unstable();\n            for w in occ.windows(2) {\n                assert!(\n                    w[0].1 <= w[1].0,\n                    \"page {} record intervals overlap: {:?}\",\n                    info.page,\n                    w\n                );\n            }\n            for (a, b) in &occ {\n                assert!(*a >= DATA_START as u32 && *b <= DATA_END as u32);\n                assert!(a < b, \"zero-length record on page {}\", info.page);\n            }\n            for w in info.free_intervals.windows(2) {\n                assert!(w[0].1 <= w[1].0, \"free intervals overlap on page {}\", info.page);\n            }\n            for (a, b) in &info.free_intervals {\n                assert!(a < b, \"empty free interval on page {}\", info.page);\n            }\n\n            // ---------- 2. 空间守恒（单页）----------\n            let free_len: u32 = info.free_intervals.iter().map(|(a, b)| b - a).sum();\n            let accounted =\n                PAGE_HEADER_SIZE as u32 + info.nslots as u32 * SLOT_ENTRY_SIZE as u32\n                    + info.used_bytes as u32\n                    + free_len;\n            assert_eq!(\n                accounted, PAGE_SIZE as u32,\n                \"space not conserved on page {}: header+slots+used+free={accounted}\",\n                info.page\n            );\n            total_used += info.used_bytes;\n\n            // 空闲补集必须恰好等于记录区间集合。\n            let slot_front =\n                (PAGE_HEADER_SIZE + info.nslots * SLOT_ENTRY_SIZE) as u32;\n            let mut complement = Vec::new();\n            let mut cur = slot_front;\n            for (a, b) in &info.free_intervals {\n                if *a > cur {\n                    complement.push((cur, *a));\n                }\n                cur = *b;\n            }\n            if cur < DATA_END as u32 {\n                complement.push((cur, DATA_END as u32));\n            }\n            assert_eq!(complement, occ, \"free complement != record intervals on page {}\", info.page);\n\n            // 第一段空闲必须贴槽区前沿，最后一段必须到页末（可能为同一段）。\n            if let Some((a0, _)) = info.free_intervals.first() {\n                assert_eq!(*a0, slot_front);\n            }\n            if let Some((_, bl)) = info.free_intervals.last() {\n                assert_eq!(*bl, DATA_END as u32);\n            }\n\n            // ---------- 3. 槽位集合与模型一致 ----------\n            let actual: BTreeSet<(u16, u32, u16)> =\n                info.slots.iter().map(|(s, _, l, g)| (*s, *g, *l)).collect();\n            let exp = expected.remove(&info.page).unwrap_or_default();\n            assert_eq!(actual, exp, \"slot set mismatch on page {}\", info.page);\n        }\n        assert!(\n            expected.is_empty(),\n            \"model references pages absent in store: {:?}\",\n            expected.keys().collect::<Vec<_>>()\n        );\n\n        // ---------- 2b. 全局空间守恒 ----------\n        assert_eq!(total_used, expected_bytes, \"global used bytes mismatch\");\n\n        // ---------- 4. 句柄语义 ----------\n        for (id, payload) in &self.live {\n            assert_eq!(&store.get(id).unwrap(), payload, \"live payload mismatch {id}\");\n        }\n        for id in &self.dead {\n            assert!(store.get(id).is_err(), \"dead handle {id} still readable\");\n            assert!(store.free(id).is_err(), \"double free of {id} succeeded\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn payload(seed: u64, size: usize) -> Vec<u8> {\n    (0..size)\n        .map(|i| seed.wrapping_add(i as u64).to_le_bytes()[0] ^ (i as u8))\n        .collect()\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn reference_model_random_workload() {\n    let store = mem_store();\n    let mut model = Model::default();\n    let mut rng = Rng(0x1234_5678_9abc_def0);\n\n    for step in 0..5000 {\n        let roll = rng.range(100);\n        if roll < 55 {\n            // ---- put：随机长度，偶尔逼近整页容量以触发跨页 ----\n            let mut size = 1 + rng.range(260);\n            if rng.range(25) == 0 {\n                size = 3000 + rng.range(500);\n            }\n            let data = payload(rng.next_u64(), size);\n            let id = store.put(&data).expect(\"put\");\n            assert!(!model.dead.contains(&id), \"fresh handle collides with a dead one\");\n            model.live.insert(id, data);\n        } else if roll < 80 {\n            // ---- delete：随机存活句柄，随后立即重复释放 ----\n            if !model.live.is_empty() {\n                let idx = rng.range(model.live.len() as u64);\n                let id = model.live.keys().nth(idx).unwrap().clone();\n                store.free(&id).expect(\"free live\");\n                store.free(&id).expect_err(\"double free must fail\");\n                store.get(&id).expect_err(\"freed handle unreadable\");\n                model.live.remove(&id);\n                model.dead.insert(id);\n            }\n        } else if roll < 95 {\n            // ---- get：存活/失效句柄随机读 ----\n            let read_dead = rng.range(2) == 0 && !model.dead.is_empty();\n            if read_dead {\n                let id = model.dead.iter().nth(rng.range(model.dead.len() as u64)).unwrap().clone();\n                assert!(store.get(&id).is_err());\n            } else if !model.live.is_empty() {\n                let idx = rng.range(model.live.len() as u64);\n                let (id, p) = model.live.iter().nth(idx).unwrap();\n                assert_eq!(&store.get(id).unwrap(), p);\n            }\n        } else {\n            // ---- compact：随机选一页，压缩，句柄必须全部存活 ----\n            let npages = store.status().npages;\n            if npages > 0 {\n                let page = 1 + rng.range(npages as u64) as u32;\n                let before: BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> = model\n                    .live\n                    .iter()\n                    .filter(|(id, _)| Handle::parse(id).unwrap().page == page)\n                    .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), v.clone()))\n                    .collect();\n                store.compact_page(page).unwrap();\n                for (id, p) in &before {\n                    assert_eq!(&store.get(id).unwrap(), p, \"compaction broke handle {id}\");\n                }\n                assert!(\n                    store.page_info(page).unwrap().free_intervals.len() <= 1,\n                    \"page {page} still fragmented after compaction\"\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        if step < 80 || step % 128 == 0 {\n            model.assert_invariants(&store);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 最终：压缩所有页，全部句柄仍有效，空间仍守恒。\n    let npages = store.status().npages;\n    for p in 1..=npages {\n        store.compact_page(p).unwrap();\n    }\n    model.assert_invariants(&store);\n    assert!(model.live.len() + model.dead.len() > 0, \"workload did nothing\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn constructed_fragmentation_and_compaction() {\n    // 手工构造碎片化：分配 -> 间隔释放制造多个空洞 -> 再分配填洞，\n    // 全程检查无重叠/守恒；压缩后存活句柄语义不变。\n    let store = mem_store();\n    let mut live: BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> = BTreeMap::new();\n    let mut dead: BTreeSet<String> = BTreeSet::new();\n\n    for i in 0u8..60 {\n        let data = vec![i; 30 + (i as usize % 7) * 11];\n        let id = store.put(&data).unwrap();\n        live.insert(id, data);\n    }\n    let ids: Vec<String> = live.keys().cloned().collect();\n    for (i, id) in ids.iter().enumerate() {\n        if i % 2 == 0 {\n            store.free(id).unwrap();\n            live.remove(id);\n            dead.insert(id.clone());\n        }\n    }\n    Model {\n        live: live.clone(),\n        dead: dead.clone(),\n    }\n    .assert_invariants(&store);\n\n    // 再放一批较大记录，迫使系统利用碎片空洞或开新页。\n    for i in 0u8..40 {\n        let data = vec![0xA0u8.wrapping_add(i); 120 + i as usize * 3];\n        let id = store.put(&data).unwrap();\n        live.insert(id, data);\n    }\n    Model {\n        live: live.clone(),\n        dead: dead.clone(),\n    }\n    .assert_invariants(&store);\n\n    // 碎片确实存在（至少一页在压缩前有多个空闲段），然后逐页压缩。\n    let npages = store.status().npages;\n    let fragmented_before = (1..=npages)\n        .any(|p| store.page_info(p).unwrap().free_intervals.len() > 1);\n    assert!(fragmented_before, \"scenario failed to actually fragment a page\");\n\n    for p in 1..=npages {\n        store.compact_page(p).unwrap();\n    }\n    for (id, data) in &live {\n        assert_eq!(&store.get(id).unwrap(), data);\n    }\n    for id in &dead {\n        assert!(store.get(id).is_err());\n    }\n    for p in 1..=npages {\n        assert!(store.page_info(p).unwrap().free_intervals.len() <= 1);\n    }\n    Model { live, dead }.assert_invariants(&store);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn stale_handles_never_read_reused_slot() {\n    // 同槽反复释放/复用，收集一串旧代次句柄；旧句柄必须全部失败，\n    // 且绝不会把新记录内容返回给旧句柄。\n    let store = mem_store();\n    let first = store.put(b\"original\").unwrap();\n    let fh = Handle::parse(&first).unwrap();\n    store.free(&first).unwrap();\n\n    let mut old_handles = vec![first.clone()];\n    for i in 1u8..=8 {\n        let id = store\n            .put(&vec![b'a' + i; 20 + i as usize])\n            .unwrap();\n        let h = Handle::parse(&id).unwrap();\n        // 都应复用同一个墓碑槽（页相同、槽相同、代次递增）。\n        assert_eq!((h.page, h.slot), (fh.page, fh.slot));\n        assert_eq!(h.gen, 1 + i as u32);\n        store.free(&id).unwrap();\n        old_handles.push(id);\n    }\n\n    let newest_data = b\"brand-new-content\".to_vec();\n    let newest = store.put(&newest_data).unwrap();\n    let nh = Handle::parse(&newest).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!((nh.page, nh.slot), (fh.page, fh.slot));\n    assert_eq!(nh.gen, 10);\n\n    for old in &old_handles {\n        let err = store.get(old).unwrap_err();\n        let msg = err.to_string();\n        assert!(\n            msg.contains(\"stale\") || msg.contains(\"already been freed\"),\n            \"unexpected error for old handle: {msg}\"\n        );\n        // 关键安全属性：旧句柄绝不能返回新记录的字节。\n        assert_ne!(store.get(old).unwrap_or_default(), newest_data);\n    }\n    assert_eq!(store.get(&newest).unwrap(), newest_data);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn oversized_and_empty_records_rejected() {\n    let store = mem_store();\n    let err = store.put(&[]).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, pfs::Error::EmptyRecord));\n    let big = vec![0u8; pfs::disk::MAX_RECORD + 1];\n    let err = store.put(&big).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, pfs::Error::RecordTooLarge { .. }));\n    // 恰好上限可以放下。\n    let ok = vec![0x5Au8; pfs::disk::MAX_RECORD];\n    let id = store.put(&ok).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(store.get(&id).unwrap().len(), pfs::disk::MAX_RECORD);\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_5249718010ec6578da9c52ba","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":621,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":81720,"output_tokens":4064,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_qkwbljar6gz9uowwqrjk7kx4":{"content":"//! {"parentUuid":"151b39d9-4be1-4794-9b17-8d46426192d2","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_a89u739yl2aab74m742qjwl7","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/a/tests/fault_injection.rs","content":"//! 故障注入测试：可注入 I/O 层模拟写失败、撕裂写、sync 失败。\n//!\n//! 验证点：\n//! - 写失败时**内存状态不前进**（句柄不产生、页数不增加、已有句柄仍一致）；\n//! - 故障解除后存储可继续正常服务（错误不污染状态）；\n//! - 撕裂写使磁盘帧 CRC 失配，重新打开时被明确报告为损坏，而不是静默读错；\n//! - sync 失败只影响持久性声明，不影响已完成的数据变更本身。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse pfs::io::{FaultPlan, FaultyStorage, MemStorage, StorageIo};\nuse pfs::store::Store;\n\n/// 直接在 `Arc<dyn StorageIo>` 上构造故障存储（便于同时持有底层镜像）。\nfn build() -> (\n    Arc<Store>,\n    Arc<Mutex<FaultPlan>>,\n    Arc<Mutex<Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)>>>,\n) {\n    // 用共享快照向量的自定义内存后端，避免 clone 整个 MemStorage。\n    struct Shared(Arc<Mutex<Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)>>>);\n    impl StorageIo for Shared {\n        fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            let frames = self.0.lock().unwrap();\n            let f = frames\n                .iter()\n                .find(|(n, _)| *n == frame_no)\n                .ok_or_else(|| {\n                    std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof, \"no frame\")\n                })?;\n            if f.1.len() != buf.len() {\n                return Err(std::io::Error::new(\n                    std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                    format!(\"frame {} torn: {} bytes\", frame_no, f.1.len()),\n                ));\n            }\n            buf.copy_from_slice(&f.1);\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            let mut frames = self.0.lock().unwrap();\n            if let Some(slot) = frames.iter_mut().find(|(n, _)| *n == frame_no) {\n                slot.1 = data.to_vec();\n            } else {\n                frames.push((frame_no, data.to_vec()));\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        fn sync(&self) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            Ok(())\n        }\n    }\n\n    let frames = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new()));\n    let plan = Arc::new(Mutex::new(FaultPlan::default()));\n    let io: Arc<dyn StorageIo> = Arc::new(FaultyStorage::new(Shared(Arc::clone(&frames)), Arc::clone(&plan)));\n    let store = Arc::new(Store::create(io).unwrap());\n    (store, plan, frames)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn failed_write_does_not_advance_state() {\n    let (store, plan, frames) = build();\n\n    let id1 = store.put(b\"first-record\").unwrap();\n    // 下一次 write 直接失败。\n    *plan.lock().unwrap() = FaultPlan {\n        fail_write_at: Some(1),\n        ..Default::default()\n    };\n    let err = store.put(b\"should-not-land\").unwrap_err();\n    assert!(err.to_string().to_lowercase().contains(\"injected fault\"), \"{err}\");\n\n    // 清除故障：存储状态没有被半成品污染。\n    *plan.lock().unwrap() = FaultPlan::default();\n    assert_eq!(store.get(&id1).unwrap(), b\"first-record\");\n    assert!(store.get(\"p1s99g1\").is_err());\n\n    // 后续写正常工作。\n    let id2 = store.put(b\"after-recovery\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(store.get(&id2).unwrap(), b\"after-recovery\");\n    assert_eq!(store.status().live_records, 2);\n\n    // 磁盘镜像里每个帧都是完整的 PAGE_SIZE（没有半帧残留）。\n    for (n, f) in frames.lock().unwrap().iter() {\n        assert_eq!(f.len(), pfs::disk::PAGE_SIZE, \"frame {n} has odd size\");\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn failed_superblock_write_leaves_no_orphan_reference() {\n    // 触发新页分配时让“第二次写”（超级块提升）失败：页帧可能已落，\n    // 但 npages 不前进；重新打开后不得引用该页。\n    let frames = {\n        let (store, plan, frames) = build();\n        // 填满第一页后，下一次 put 需要两帧写：先页帧(1)、再超级块。\n        // 先放足够多记录（小记录），再安排第 N 次写失败比较脆弱；\n        // 更直接：直接放一条 MAX_RECORD 记录占满数据页，第二次 put 必开新页。\n        let _id0 = store\n            .put(&vec![0x42u8; pfs::disk::MAX_RECORD])\n            .unwrap();\n        // 此时计数：create 的超块(写#1)、id0 页帧(#2)。\n        // 下一次 put：写新页帧(#3 成功)、写超块(#4 失败)。\n        *plan.lock().unwrap() = FaultPlan {\n            fail_write_at: Some(4),\n            ..Default::default()\n        };\n        let err = store.put(b\"orphan-page-record\").unwrap_err();\n        assert!(err.to_string().to_lowercase().contains(\"injected fault\"));\n        *plan.lock().unwrap() = FaultPlan::default();\n\n        // 内存中 npages 仍为 1，存活记录只有 id0。\n        assert_eq!(store.status().npages, 1);\n        assert_eq!(store.status().live_records, 1);\n        frames\n    };\n\n    // 用相同磁盘镜像重新打开（新 FaultyStorage，计划为空）。\n    struct Shared2(Arc<Mutex<Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)>>>);\n    impl StorageIo for Shared2 {\n        fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            let frames = self.0.lock().unwrap();\n            let f = frames\n                .iter()\n                .find(|(n, _)| *n == frame_no)\n                .ok_or_else(|| std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof, \"no frame\"))?;\n            buf.copy_from_slice(&f.1);\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            let mut fs = self.0.lock().unwrap();\n            if let Some(s) = fs.iter_mut().find(|(n, _)| *n == frame_no) {\n                s.1 = data.to_vec();\n            } else {\n                fs.push((frame_no, data.to_vec()));\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        fn sync(&self) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            Ok(())\n        }\n    }\n    let io: Arc<dyn StorageIo> = Arc::new(Shared2(frames));\n    let reopened = Store::open(io).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(reopened.status().npages, 1);\n    assert_eq!(reopened.status().live_records, 1);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn torn_write_is_detected_as_corruption() {\n    let (store, plan, frames) = build();\n    let _id = store.put(b\"survivor\").unwrap();\n    // 让下一次写变成半帧撕裂。\n    *plan.lock().unwrap() = FaultPlan {\n        torn_write_at: Some(1),\n        ..Default::default()\n    };\n    // free 对现有页帧的写被撕裂：调用本身返回成功（模拟“写成功但落盘不完整”）。\n    store.free(&_id).unwrap();\n    *plan.lock().unwrap() = FaultPlan::default();\n\n    // 被撕裂的是页帧 1；镜像中它应只有半页大小。\n 槽区从低地址向高地址增长，记录从页末（4096）向低地址增长，中间是\n//! 连续/碎片空闲空间。记录偏移永远指向数据区 `[DATA_START, DATA_END)`。\n\nuse crate::crc::crc32;\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\n\n/// 帧大小（同时也是文件 I/O 的原子单位）。\npub const PAGE_SIZE: usize = 4096;\n\n/// 超级块魔数。\npub const SUPER_MAGIC: &[u8; 4] = b\"PFS1\";\n/// 数据页魔数。\npub const PAGE_MAGIC: &[u8; 4] = b\"PFPG\";\n/// 磁盘格式版本。\npub const FORMAT_VERSION: u32 = 1;\n\n// --- 数据页常量 ---\n\n/// 页头大小。\npub const PAGE_HEADER_SIZE: usize = 32;\n/// 每页最大槽位数（槽区固定预留）。\npub const MAX_SLOTS: usize = 64;\n/// 单个槽项的序列化大小。\npub const SLOT_ENTRY_SIZE: usize = 8;\n/// 槽区大小。\npub const SLOT_AREA_SIZE: usize = MAX_SLOTS * SLOT_ENTRY_SIZE; // 512\n/// 数据区起始偏移。\npub const DATA_START: usize = PAGE_HEADER_SIZE + SLOT_AREA_SIZE; // 544\n/// 数据区结束偏移（页末）。\npub const DATA_END: usize = PAGE_SIZE; // 4096\n/// 数据区总字节数，即单条记录长度上限。\npub const MAX_RECORD: usize = DATA_END - DATA_START; // 3552\n\n// 页头字段偏移\nconst OFF_MAGIC: usize = 0;\nconst OFF_VERSION: usize = 4;\nconst OFF_PAGE_ID: write_u32(&mut buf[12..16], self.npages);\n        let c = crc32(&buf);\n        write_u32(&mut buf[16..20], c);\n        buf\n    }\n\n    /// 从帧解析，校验魔数/版本/页大小/CRC。\n    pub fn decode(buf: &[u8]) -> write_u32(&mut buf[OFF_LIVE_COUNT..OFF_LIVE_COUNT + 4], live_count);\n}\n\n/// 校验并解析页头，返回 `(page_id, nslots, free_start, live_count)`。\npub(crate) fn parse_page_header(buf: &[u8]) -> Result<(u32, u16, .unwrap();","originalFile":"//! 故障注入测试：可注入 I/O 层模拟写失败、撕裂写、sync 失败。\n//!\n//! 验证点：\n//! - 写失败时**内存状态不前进**（句柄不产生、页数不增加、已有句柄仍一致）；\n//! - 故障解除后存储可继续正常服务（错误不污染状态）；\n//! - 撕裂写使磁盘帧 CRC 失配，重新打开时被明确报告为损坏，而不是静默读错；\n//! - sync 失败只影响持久性声明，不影响已完成的数据变更本身。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse pfs::io::{FaultPlan, FaultyStorage, MemStorage, StorageIo};\nuse pfs::store::Store;\n\n/// 直接在 `Arc<dyn StorageIo>` 上构造故障存储（便于同时持有底层镜像）。\nfn build() -> (\n    Arc<Store>,\n    Arc<Mutex<FaultPlan>>,\n    Arc<Mutex<Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)>>>,\n) {\n    // 用共享快照向量的自定义内存后端，避免 clone 整个 MemStorage。\n    struct Shared(Arc<Mutex<Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)>>>);\n    impl StorageIo for Shared {\n        fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            let frames = self.0.lock().unwrap();\n            let f = frames\n                .iter()\n                .find(|(n, _)| *n == frame_no)\n                .ok_or_else(|| {\n                    std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof, \"no frame\")\n                })?;\n            if f.1.len() != buf.len() {\n                return Err(std::io::Error::new(\n                    std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                    format!(\"frame {} torn: {} bytes\", frame_no, f.1.len()),\n                ));\n            }\n            buf.copy_from_slice(&f.1);\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            let mut frames = self.0.lock().unwrap();\n            if let Some(slot) = frames.iter_mut().find(|(n, _)| *n == frame_no) {\n                slot.1 = data.to_vec();\n            } else {\n                frames.push((frame_no, data.to_vec()));\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        fn sync(&self) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            Ok(())\n        }\n    }\n\n    let frames = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new()));\n    let plan = Arc::new(Mutex::new(FaultPlan::default()));\n    let io: Arc<dyn StorageIo> = Arc::new(FaultyStorage::new(Shared(Arc::clone(&frames)), Arc::clone(&plan)));\n    let store = Arc::new(Store::create(io).unwrap());\n    (store, plan, frames)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn failed_write_does_not_advance_state() {\n    let (store, plan, frames) = build();\n\n    let id1 = store.put(b\"first-record\").unwrap();\n    // 下一次 write 直接失败。\n    *plan.lock().unwrap() = FaultPlan {\n        fail_write_at: Some(1),\n        ..Default::default()\n    };\n    let err = store.put(b\"should-not-land\").unwrap_err();\n    assert!(err.to_string().to_lowercase().contains(\"injected fault\"), \"{err}\");\n\n    // 清除故障：存储状态没有被半成品污染。\n    *plan.lock().unwrap() = FaultPlan::default();\n    assert_eq!(store.get(&id1).unwrap(), b\"first-record\");\n    assert!(store.get(\"p1s99g1\").is_err());\n\n    // 后续写正常工作。\n    let id2 = store.put(b\"after-recovery\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(store.get(&id2).unwrap(), b\"after-recovery\");\n    assert_eq!(store.status().live_records, 2);\n\n    // 磁盘镜像里每个帧都是完整的 PAGE_SIZE（没有半帧残留）。\n failed_superblock_write_leaves_no_orphan_reference() {\n    // 触发新页分配时让“第二次写”（超级块提升）失败：页帧可能已落，\n    // 但 npages 不前进；重新打开后不得引用该页。\n    let frames = {\n        let (store, plan, frames) = build();\n buf.copy_from_slice(&f.1);\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            let mut fs = self.0.lock().unwrap();\n            if let Some(s) = fs.iter_mut().find(|(n, _)| *n == frame_no) {\n                s.1 = data.to_vec();\n            } else {\n                fs.push((frame_no, data.to_vec()));\n            }\n Store::open(io).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(reopened.status().npages, 1);\n    assert_eq!(reopened.status().live_records, 1);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn torn_write_is_detected_as_corruption() {\n    let (store, let torn_len = frames\n        .lock()\n        .unwrap()\n        .iter()\n        .find(|(n, _)| *n == 1)\n        .map(|(_, f)| f.len())\n        .unwrap();\n    assert!(torn_len < pfs::disk::PAGE_SIZE);\n\n    // 重新打开必须报损坏（CRC/帧长度），不能静默读错。\n    struct Shared2(Arc<Mutex<Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)>>>);\n    impl StorageIo for Shared2 {\n        fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            let frames = self.0.lock().unwrap();\n            let f = frames\n                .iter()\n                .find(|(n, _)| *n == frame_no)\n std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                    format!(\"frame {frame_no} torn: {}\", f.1.len()),\n                ));\n            }\n            buf.copy_from_slice(&f.1);\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        fn write_frame(&self, _: u64, _: &[u8]) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        fn sync(&self) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            Ok(())\n        }\n    }\n    let io: Arc<dyn StorageIo> = Arc::new(Shared2(frames));\n    let err = Store::open(io).unwrap_err();\n    let msg = err.to_string().to_lowercase();\n    assert!(\n 真实文件后端的持久性 / 重开测试。\n//!\n//! 使用系统临时目录，每个测试独立子目录。\n\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse pfs::io::FileStorage;\nuse pfs::store::Store;\n\nfn temp_path(name: &str) -> std::path::PathBuf {\n    let mut dir = std::env::temp_dir();\n    dir.push(format!(\n        \"pfs-test-{}-{}-{}\",\n        name,\n        std::process::id(),\n        std::time::SystemTime::now()\n            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)\n            .unwrap()\n            .as_nanos()\n    ));\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    dir.push(\"store.pfs\");\n    dir\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn create_put_sync_reopen() {\n    let path = temp_path(\"persist\");\n\n    let (h_a, h_b, h_c) = {\n        let io: Arc<dyn pfs::StorageIo> = Arc::new(FileStorage::create(&path).unwrap());\n        let store = Store::create(io).unwrap();\n        let a = store.put(b\"alpha-record\").unwrap();\n        let b = store.put(&vec![0xCDu8; 5000]).unwrap_err(); // 超长，不落盘\n        let _ = b;\n        let b = store\n            .put(&vec![b'x'; pfs::disk::MAX_RECORD])\n            .unwrap();\n        let c = store.put(b\"gamma\").unwrap();\n        store.free(&c).unwrap();\n        store.sync().unwrap();\n        (a, b, c)\n    };\n\n    // 重新打开：存活句柄内容一致，已释放句柄失败，页数与状态恢复。\n    let io: Arc<dyn pfs::StorageIo> = Arc::new(FileStorage::open(&path).unwrap());\n    let store = Store::open(io).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(store.get(&h_a).unwrap(), b\"alpha-record\");\n    assert_eq!(store.get(&h_b).unwrap().len(), pfs::disk::MAX_RECORD);\n    assert!(store.get(&h_c).is_err());\n\n    let st = store.status();\n    assert_eq!(st.npages, 2);\n    assert_eq!(st.live_records, 2);\n\n    // 重开后继续写入与压缩也正常。\n    let h_d = store.put(b\"delta-after-reopen\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(store.get(&h_d).unwrap(), b\"delta-after-reopen\");\n    store.compact_page(1).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(store.get(&h_a).unwrap(), b\"alpha-record\");\n    store.sync().unwrap();\n\n    std::fs::remove_file(&path).ok();\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn reopen_twice_is_stable() {\n    // 多次重开不应改变磁盘镜像（每次 open 都是只读加载）。\n    let path = temp_path(\"reopen2\");\n    {\n        let io: Arc<dyn pfs::StorageIo> = Arc::new(FileStorage::create(&path).unwrap());\n        let store = Store::create(io).unwrap();\n        for i in 0u8..30 {\n            store.put(&vec![i; 50 + i as usize]).unwrap();\n        }\n        store.sync().unwrap();\n    }\n    let size1 = std::fs::metadata(&path).unwrap().len();\n    {\n        let io: Arc<dyn pfs::StorageIo> = Arc::new(FileStorage::open(&path).unwrap());\n        let store = Store::open(io).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(store.status().live_records, 30);\n    }\n    let size2 = std::fs::metadata(&path).unwrap().len();\n    assert_eq!(size1, size2, \"read-only open must not modify the file\");\n    std::fs::remove_file(&path).ok();\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_73154865e220c8c728de15ed","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1114,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":88888,"output_tokens":1015,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_xdxzney65yv69zxlolpv2w99":{"content":"//! 5000]).unwrap_err(); // 超长，不落盘\n        let _ = b;\n        let b = store\n            .put(&vec![b'x'; pfs::disk::MAX_RECORD])\n            .unwrap();\n        let c = store.put(b\"gamma\").unwrap();\n        store.free(&c).unwrap();\n        store.sync().unwrap();\n        (a, b, c)\n    };\n\n    // 重新打开：存活句柄内容一致，已释放句柄失败，页数与状态恢复。\n    let io: Arc<dyn pfs::StorageIo> = Arc::new(FileStorage::open(&path).unwrap());\n    let store = Store::open(io).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(store.get(&h_a).unwrap(), b\"alpha-record\");\n    assert_eq!(store.get(&h_b).unwrap().len(), pfs::disk::MAX_RECORD);\n    assert!(store.get(&h_c).is_err());\n\n    let st = store.status();\n    assert_eq!(st.npages, 2);\n    assert_eq!(st.live_records, 2);\n\n    // 重开后继续写入与压缩也正常。\n    let h_d = store.put(b\"delta-after-reopen\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(store.get(&h_d).unwrap(), b\"delta-after-reopen\");\n    store.compact_page(1).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(store.get(&h_a).unwrap(), b\"alpha-record\");\n    store.sync().unwrap();\n\n    std::fs::remove_file(&path).ok();\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn reopen_twice_is_stable() {\n    // 多次重开不应改变磁盘镜像（每次 open 都是只读加载）。\n    let path = temp_path(\"reopen2\");\n    {\n        let io: Arc<dyn pfs::StorageIo> = Arc::new(FileStorage::create(&path).unwrap());\n        let store = Store::create(io).unwrap();\n        for i in 0u8..30 {\n            store.put(&vec![i; 50 + i as usize]).unwrap();\n        }\n        store.sync().unwrap();\n    }\n    let size1 = std::fs::metadata(&path).unwrap().len();\n    {\n        let io: Arc<dyn pfs::StorageIo> = Arc::new(FileStorage::open(&path).unwrap());\n        let store = Store::open(io).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(store.status().live_records, 30);\n    }\n    let size2 = std::fs::metadata(&path).unwrap().len();\n    assert_eq!(size1, size2, \"read-only open must not modify the file\");\n    std::fs::remove_file(&path).ok();\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"d7e3bd08-e53d-43a0-924e-d33cb2b096ca","session_id":"728b6c9b-b77e-419f-ac5e-f62a72c8fe54","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/a","sessionId":"728b6c9b-b77e-419f-ac5e-f62a72c8fe54","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp9-a","slug":"temporal-snacking-panda"}

{"parentUuid":"49c8eab6-8fb5-4ab5-8b19-d4f52b8faf3c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_xwxbek8n439izri27mfpqr8j","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/a/tests/http_api.rs","content":"//! HTTP 验证入口的端到端测试（真实 TCP 回环，纯 std 客户端）。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse pfs::http::Server;\nuse pfs::io::{FaultPlan, FaultyStorage, MemStorage, StorageIo};\nuse pfs::store::Store;\n\nuse common::{extract_id, http_request};\n\n/// 在随机空闲端口启动带故障注入端点的服务器，返回 (join 句柄, 地址)。\nfn spawn_server() -> (std::thread::JoinHandle<()>, String, Arc<Mutex<FaultPlan>>) {\n    let mem = MemStorage::new();\n    let plan = Arc::new(Mutex::new(FaultPlan::default()));\n    let faulty = FaultyStorage::new(mem, Arc::clone(&plan));\n    let io: Arc<dyn StorageIo> = Arc::new(faulty);\n    let store = Arc::new(Store::create(io).unwrap());\n    let server = Server::with_faults(store, Arc::clone(&plan));\n    let listener = std::net::TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();\n    let handle = std::thread::spawn(move || {\n        server.run_listener(listener);\n    });\n    std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(50));\n    (handle, addr, plan)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_crud_lifecycle_and_errors() {\n    let (_h, addr, _plan) = spawn_server();\n\n    // status：初始空库。\n    let (st, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", \"/status\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200);\n    assert!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&body).contains(\"\\\"npages\\\":0\"));\n\n    // put 三条记录。\n    let mut ids = Vec::new();\n    for payload in [&b\"record-one\"[..], b\"record-two\", b\"xx\"] {\n        let (st, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", payload);\n        assert_eq!(st, 201, \"{}\", String::from_utf8_lossy(&body));\n        ids.push(extract_id(&body));\n    }\n\n    // get：原始字节往返（含非 UTF-8）。\n    let binary = vec![0u8, 1, 2, 255, 254, 128];\n    let (_, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", &binary);\n    let bin_id = extract_id(&body);\n    let (st, headers, body) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records/{bin_id}\"), b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200);\n    assert_eq!(body, binary);\n    assert!(\n        headers\n            .iter()\n            .any(|(k, v)| k.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"content-type\")\n                && v.contains(\"octet-stream\")),\n        \"raw content type expected: {headers:?}\"\n    );\n\n    // delete 成功；重复 delete → 409；旧句柄再 get → 409。\n    let (st, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"DELETE\", &format!(\"/records/{}\", ids[0]), b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200, \"{}\", String::from_utf8_lossy(&body));\n    let (st, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"DELETE\", &format!(\"/records/{}\", ids[0]), b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 409);\n    let (st, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records/{}\", ids[0]), b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 409);\n\n    // 槽位复用后，旧句柄 → 410 Gone（stale）。\n    let (_, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", b\"new-occupant\", );\n    let _new_id = extract_id(&body);\n    // ids[0] 的槽很可能被新记录复用；若恰好分配到别处，则再制造复用：\n    let stale_status = loop {\n        let (st, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records/{}\", ids[0]), b\"\");\n        if st == 410 {\n            break st;\n        }\n        let (_, _, b2) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", b\"filler\", );\n        let _ = extract_id(&b2);\n        let (st2, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records/{}\", ids[0]), b\"\");\n        break st2;\n    };\n    assert_eq!(stale_status, 410);\n\n    // 坏句柄 → 400；不存在的页 → 404。\n    let (st, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", \"/records/not-a-handle\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 400);\n    let (st, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", \"/records/p9999s0g1\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 404);\n\n    // 空体 → 400；超长 → 400。\n    let (st, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 400);\n    let big = vec![0u8; pfs::disk::MAX_RECORD + 1];\n    let (st, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", &big);\n    assert_eq!(st, 400);\n\n    // 压缩与布局接口。\n    let (st, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/pages/1/compact\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200, \"{}\", String::from_utf8_lossy(&body));\n    let (st, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", \"/pages/1\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200);\n    let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&body);\n    assert!(s.contains(\"\\\"free_intervals\\\"\"));\n    let (st, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", \"/pages\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200);\n\n    // sync。\n    let (st, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/sync\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200, \"{}\", String::from_utf8_lossy(&body));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_fault_injection_endpoint() {\n    let (_h, addr, _plan) = spawn_server();\n\n    // 让下一次 write 失败。\n    let (st, _, body) =\n        http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/debug/fault?fail_write=1\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200, \"{}\", String::from_utf8_lossy(&body));\n    let (st, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", b\"will-fail\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 500);\n    assert!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&body).contains(\"io_error\"));\n\n    // 清除故障后恢复正常。\n    let (st, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/debug/fault\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200);\n    let (st, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", b\"recovered\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 201, \"{}\", String::from_utf8_lossy(&body));\n\n    // 撕裂写：下一次写半帧，随后访问触发校验/读取错误。\n    let (_, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/debug/fault?torn_write=1\", b\"\");\n    let _id = {\n        let (_, _, b) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", b\"torn\", );\n        extract_id(&b)\n    };\n    // 撕裂落在某一帧；再次读取时，若该页未被缓存之外的重读不会暴露，\n    // 因此这里主要验证故障计划被接受且计数注入发生（服务仍可响应）。\n    let (st, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", \"/status\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200);\n\n    // sync 失败 → 500。\n    let (_, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/debug/fault?fail_sync=1\", b\"\");\n    let (st, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/sync\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 500);\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_c4979663f3016f0dfab034d9","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1142,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":89912,"output_tokens":2218,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_xwxbek8n439izri27mfpqr8j":{"content":"//! I/O 错误，或把某次写变成只落半页的**撕裂写**。\n\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::fs::{File, OpenOptions};\nuse std::io;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse std::os::unix::fs::FileExt;\n\nuse crate::disk::PAGE_SIZE;\n\n/// 帧存储抽象。`frame_no` 即帧号（0 为超级块，页号 = 数据页帧号）。\npub trait StorageIo: Send + Sync {\n    /// 将恰好一帧读入 `buf`（长度必须为 [`PAGE_SIZE`]）；越过文件尾返回 EOF 错误。\n    fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 将一帧写入指定帧号（部分长度也允许，用于模拟撕裂写）。\n    fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 强制把已写入的数据刷到物理介质。\n    fn sync(&self) -> io::Result<()>;\n}\n\nimpl<S: StorageIo + ?Sized> StorageIo for Box<S> {\n    fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        (**self).read_frame(frame_no, buf)\n    }\n    fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        (**self).write_frame(frame_no, data)\n    }\n    fn sync(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        (**self).sync()\n    }\n}\n\n/// 真实文件后端。\npub struct FileStorage {\n    file: File,\n}\n\nimpl FileStorage {\n    /// 创建全新的空存储文件（要求路径不存在）。\n    pub fn create(path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> io::Result<Self> {\n        if let Some(parent) = path.as_ref().parent() {\n            if !parent.as_os_str().is_empty() {\n                std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;\n            }\n        }\n        let file = OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .create_new(true)\n            .open(path)?;\n        Ok(FileStorage { file })\n    }\n\n    /// 打开已有存储文件。\n    pub fn open(path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> io::Result<Self> {\n        let file = OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .open(path)?;\n        Ok(FileStorage { file })\n    }\n}\n\nimpl StorageIo for FileStorage {\n    fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        debug_assert_eq!(buf.len(), PAGE_SIZE);\n        let off = frame_no * PAGE_SIZE as u64;\n        let n = self.file.read_at(buf, off)?;\n        if n != buf.len() {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(\n                io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof,\n                format!(\"short read at frame {frame_no}: {n}/{PAGE_SIZE} bytes\"),\n            ));\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        debug_assert!(data.len() <= PAGE_SIZE);\n        let off = frame_no * PAGE_SIZE as u64;\n        self.file.write_all_at(data, off)\n    }\n\n    fn sync(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.file.sync_all()\n    }\n}\n\n/// 纯内存后端：帧号 -> 字节。写半帧会真的只存半帧，因此撕裂写可被 CRC 检出。\n#[derive(Default, Clone)]\npub struct MemStorage {\n    frames: Mutex<HashMap<u64, Vec<u8>>>,\n    sync_count: Mutex<u64>,\n}\n\nimpl MemStorage {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        Self::default()\n    }\n\n    pub fn sync_count(&self) -> u64 {\n        *self.sync_count.lock().unwrap()\n    }\n\n    /// 快照（帧号排序），供测试检查磁盘镜像。\n    pub fn snapshot(&self) -> Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)> {\n        let frames = self.frames.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut v: Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)> =\n            frames.iter().map(|(k, v)| (*k, v.clone())).collect();\n        v.sort_by_key(|(k, _)| *k);\n        v\n    }\n}\n\nimpl StorageIo for MemStorage {\n    fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        debug_assert_eq!(buf.len(), PAGE_SIZE);\n        let frames = self.frames.lock().unwrap();\n        let frame = frames.get(&frame_no).ok_or_else(|| {\n            io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof, format!(\"no frame {frame_no}\"))\n        })?;\n        if frame.len() != buf.len() {\n            // 典型场景：该帧被撕裂写成半帧。\n            return Err(io::Error::new(\n                io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                format!(\n                    \"frame {frame_no} is {} bytes (expected {PAGE_SIZE}); likely torn\",\n                    frame.len()\n                ),\n            ));\n        }\n        buf.copy_from_slice(frame);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.frames\n            .lock()\n            .unwrap()\n            .insert(frame_no, data.to_vec());\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn sync(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        *self.sync_count.lock().unwrap() += 1;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// 故障计划：所有阈值都是“第 N 次调用（从 1 开始）”；`None` 表示不注入。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct FaultPlan {\n    /// 第 N 次 write 直接返回 EIO（调用不触及内层存储）。\n    pub fail_write_at: Option<u64>,\n    /// 第 N 次 write 只落前半帧且返回成功（撕裂写）。\n    pub torn_write_at: Option<u64>,\n    /// 第 N 次 sync 返回 EIO。\n    pub fail_sync_at: Option<u64>,\n    /// 第 N 次 read 返回 EIO。\n    pub fail_read_at: Option<u64>,\n}\n\n/// 已发生的调用计数。\n#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone)]\npub struct FaultCounters {\n    pub reads: u64,\n    pub writes: u64,\n    pub torn: u64,\n    pub syncs: u64,\n}\n\n/// 故障注入包装层。\npub struct FaultyStorage<S: StorageIo> {\n    inner: S,\n    plan: Arc<Mutex<FaultPlan>>,\n    counters: Mutex<FaultCounters>,\n}\n\nimpl<S: StorageIo> FaultyStorage<S> {\n    pub fn new(inner: S, plan: Arc<Mutex<FaultPlan>>) -> Self {\n        FaultyStorage {\n            inner,\n            plan,\n            counters: Mutex::new(FaultCounters::default()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn counters(&self) -> FaultCounters {\n        self.counters.lock().unwrap().clone()\n    }\n\n    pub fn reset_counters(&self) {\n        *self.counters.lock().unwrap() = FaultCounters::default();\n    }\n\n    fn io_err(msg: &str) -> io::Error {\n        io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::Other, format!(\"injected fault: {msg}\"))\n    }\n}\n\nimpl<S: StorageIo> StorageIo for FaultyStorage<S> {\n    fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let n = {\n            let mut c = self.counters.lock().unwrap();\n            c.reads += 1;\n            c.reads\n        };\n        if self.plan.lock().unwrap().fail_read_at == Some(n) {\n            return Err(Self::io_err(\"read failure\"));\n        }\n        self.inner.read_frame(frame_no, buf)\n    }\n\n    fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let n = {\n            let mut c = self.counters.lock().unwrap();\n            c.writes += 1;\n            c.writes\n        };\n        let plan = self.plan.lock().unwrap().clone();\n        if plan.fail_write_at == Some(n) {\n            return Err(Self::io_err(\"write failure\"));\n        }\n        if plan.torn_write_at == Some(n) {\n            // 只把前半帧交给内层：后半保持旧值/零，CRC 必然失配。\n            let half = data.len() / 2;\n            self.inner.write_frame(frame_no, &data[..half])?;\n 写失败时**内存状态不前进**（句柄不产生、页数不增加、已有句柄仍一致）；\n//! - 故障解除后存储可继续正常服务（错误不污染状态）；\n//! - 撕裂写使磁盘帧 CRC 失配，重新打开时被明确报告为损坏，而不是静默读错；\n//! - sync 失败只影响持久性声明，不影响已完成的数据变更本身。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse pfs::io::{FaultPlan, FaultyStorage, MemStorage, StorageIo};\nuse pfs::store::Store;\n\n/// 直接在 `Arc<dyn StorageIo>` 上构造故障存储（便于同时持有底层镜像）。\nfn build() -> (\n    Arc<Store>,\n    Arc<Mutex<FaultPlan>>,\n    Arc<Mutex<Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)>>>,\n) {\n    // 用共享快照向量的自定义内存后端，避免 clone 整个 MemStorage。\n    struct Shared(Arc<Mutex<Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)>>>);\n    impl StorageIo for Shared {\n        fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            let frames = self.0.lock().unwrap();\n            let f = frames\n                .iter()\n                .find(|(n, _)| *n == frame_no)\n                .ok_or_else(|| {\n                    std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof, \"no frame\")\n                })?;\n            if f.1.len() != buf.len() {\n                return Err(std::io::Error::new(\n                    std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                    format!(\"frame {} torn: {} bytes\", frame_no, f.1.len()),\n                ));\n            }\n            buf.copy_from_slice(&f.1);\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            let mut frames = self.0.lock().unwrap();\n            if let Some(slot) = frames.iter_mut().find(|(n, _)| *n == frame_no) {\n                slot.1 = data.to_vec();\n            } else {\n                frames.push((frame_no, data.to_vec()));\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        fn sync(&self) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            Ok(())\n        }\n    }\n\n    let frames = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new()));\n    let plan = Arc::new(Mutex::new(FaultPlan::default()));\n    let io: Arc<dyn StorageIo> = Arc::new(FaultyStorage::new(Shared(Arc::clone(&frames)), Arc::clone(&plan)));\n    let store = Arc::new(Store::create(io).unwrap());\n    (store, plan, frames)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn failed_write_does_not_advance_state() {\n    let (store, plan, frames) = build();\n\n    let id1 = store.put(b\"first-record\").unwrap();\n    // 下一次 write 直接失败。\n    *plan.lock().unwrap() = FaultPlan {\n        fail_write_at: Some(1),\n        ..Default::default()\n    };\n    let err = store.put(b\"should-not-land\").unwrap_err();\n    assert!(err.to_string().to_lowercase().contains(\"injected fault\"), \"{err}\");\n\n    // 清除故障：存储状态没有被半成品污染。\n    *plan.lock().unwrap() = FaultPlan::default();\n    assert_eq!(store.get(&id1).unwrap(), b\"first-record\");\n    assert!(store.get(\"p1s99g1\").is_err());\n\n    // 后续写正常工作。\n    let id2 = store.put(b\"after-recovery\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(store.get(&id2).unwrap(), b\"after-recovery\");\n    assert_eq!(store.status().live_records, 2);\n\n    // 磁盘镜像里每个帧都是完整的 PAGE_SIZE（没有半帧残留）。\n buf.copy_from_slice(&f.1);\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            let mut fs = self.0.lock().unwrap();\n HTTP 验证入口的端到端测试（真实 TCP 回环，纯 std 客户端）。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse pfs::http::Server;\nuse pfs::io::{FaultPlan, FaultyStorage, MemStorage, StorageIo};\nuse pfs::store::Store;\n\nuse common::{extract_id, http_request};\n\n/// 在随机空闲端口启动带故障注入端点的服务器，返回 (join 句柄, 地址)。\nfn spawn_server() -> (std::thread::JoinHandle<()>, String, Arc<Mutex<FaultPlan>>) {\n    let mem = MemStorage::new();\n    let plan = Arc::new(Mutex::new(FaultPlan::default()));\n    let faulty = FaultyStorage::new(mem, Arc::clone(&plan));\n    let io: Arc<dyn StorageIo> = Arc::new(faulty);\n    let store = Arc::new(Store::create(io).unwrap());\n    let server = Server::with_faults(store, Arc::clone(&plan));\n    let listener = std::net::TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();\n    let handle = std::thread::spawn(move || {\n        server.run_listener(listener);\n    });\n    std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(50));\n    (handle, addr, plan)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_crud_lifecycle_and_errors() {\n    let (_h, addr, _plan) = spawn_server();\n\n    // status：初始空库。\n    let (st, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", \"/status\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200);\n    assert!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&body).contains(\"\\\"npages\\\":0\"));\n\n    // put 三条记录。\n    let mut ids = Vec::new();\n    for payload in [&b\"record-one\"[..], b\"record-two\", b\"xx\"] {\n        let (st, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", payload);\n        assert_eq!(st, 201, \"{}\", String::from_utf8_lossy(&body));\n        ids.push(extract_id(&body));\n    }\n\n    // get：原始字节往返（含非 UTF-8）。\n    let binary = vec![0u8, 1, 2, 255, 254, 128];\n    let (_, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", &binary);\n    let bin_id = extract_id(&body);\n    let (st, headers, body) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records/{bin_id}\"), b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200);\n    assert_eq!(body, binary);\n    assert!(\n        headers\n            .iter()\n            .any(|(k, v)| k.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"content-type\")\n                && v.contains(\"octet-stream\")),\n        \"raw content type expected: {headers:?}\"\n    );\n\n    // delete 成功；重复 delete → 409；旧句柄再 get → 409。\n    let (st, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"DELETE\", &format!(\"/records/{}\", ids[0]), b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200, \"{}\", String::from_utf8_lossy(&body));\n    let (st, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"DELETE\", &format!(\"/records/{}\", ids[0]), b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 409);\n    let (st, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records/{}\", ids[0]), b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 409);\n\n    // 槽位复用后，旧句柄 → 410 Gone（stale）。\n    let (_, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", b\"new-occupant\", );\n    let _new_id = extract_id(&body);\n    // ids[0] 的槽很可能被新记录复用；若恰好分配到别处，则再制造复用：\n    let stale_status = loop {\n        let (st, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records/{}\", ids[0]), b\"\");\n        if st == 410 {\n            break st;\n        }\n        let (_, _, b2) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", b\"filler\", );\n        let _ = extract_id(&b2);\n        let (st2, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records/{}\", ids[0]), b\"\");\n        break st2;\n    };\n    assert_eq!(stale_status, 410);\n\n    // 坏句柄 → 400；不存在的页 → 404。\n    let (st, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", \"/records/not-a-handle\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 400);\n    let (st, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", \"/records/p9999s0g1\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 404);\n\n    // 空体 → 400；超长 → 400。\n    let (st, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 400);\n    let big = vec![0u8; pfs::disk::MAX_RECORD + 1];\n    let (st, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", &big);\n    assert_eq!(st, 400);\n\n    // 压缩与布局接口。\n    let (st, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/pages/1/compact\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200, \"{}\", String::from_utf8_lossy(&body));\n    let (st, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", \"/pages/1\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200);\n    let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&body);\n    assert!(s.contains(\"\\\"free_intervals\\\"\"));\n    let (st, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", \"/pages\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200);\n\n    // sync。\n    let (st, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/sync\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200, \"{}\", String::from_utf8_lossy(&body));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_fault_injection_endpoint() {\n    let (_h, addr, _plan) = spawn_server();\n\n    // 让下一次 write 失败。\n    let (st, _, body) =\n        http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/debug/fault?fail_write=1\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200, \"{}\", String::from_utf8_lossy(&body));\n    let (st, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", b\"will-fail\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 500);\n };\n    // 撕裂落在某一帧；再次读取时，若该页未被缓存之外的重读不会暴露，\n    // 因此这里主要验证故障计划被接受且计数注入发生（服务仍可响应）。\n    let (st, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", \"/status\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200);\n\n    // sync 失败 → 500。\n    let (_, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/debug/fault?fail_sync=1\", b\"\");\n    let (st, _, _) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/sync\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, I/O 错误，或把某次写变成只落半页的**撕裂写**。\n\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::fs::{File, OpenOptions};\nuse std::io;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse std::os::unix::fs::FileExt;\n\nuse crate::disk::PAGE_SIZE;\n\n/// 帧存储抽象。`frame_no` 即帧号（0 为超级块，页号 = 数据页帧号）。\npub trait StorageIo: Send + Sync {\n    /// 将恰好一帧读入 `buf`（长度必须为 [`PAGE_SIZE`]）；越过文件尾返回 EOF 错误。\n    fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 将一帧写入指定帧号（部分长度也允许，用于模拟撕裂写）。\n    fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 强制把已写入的数据刷到物理介质。\n    fn sync(&self) -> io::Result<()>;\n}\n\nimpl<S: StorageIo + ?Sized> StorageIo for Box<S> {\n    fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        (**self).read_frame(frame_no, buf)\n    }\n    fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        (**self).write_frame(frame_no, data)\n    }\n    fn sync(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        (**self).sync()\n    }\n}\n\n/// 真实文件后端。\npub struct FileStorage {\n    file: File,\n}\n\nimpl FileStorage {\n    /// 创建全新的空存储文件（要求路径不存在）。\n    pub fn create(path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> io::Result<Self> {\n        if let Some(parent) = path.as_ref().parent() {\n            if !parent.as_os_str().is_empty() {\n                std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;\n            }\n        }\n        let file = OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .create_new(true)\n            .open(path)?;\n        Ok(FileStorage { file })\n    }\n\n    /// 打开已有存储文件。\n    pub fn open(path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> io::Result<Self> {\n        let file = OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .open(path)?;\n        Ok(FileStorage { file })\n    }\n}\n\nimpl StorageIo for FileStorage {\n    fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        debug_assert_eq!(buf.len(), PAGE_SIZE);\n        let off = frame_no * PAGE_SIZE as u64;\n        let n = self.file.read_at(buf, off)?;\n        if n != buf.len() {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(\n                io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof,\n                format!(\"short read at frame {frame_no}: {n}/{PAGE_SIZE} bytes\"),\n            ));\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        debug_assert!(data.len() <= PAGE_SIZE);\n        let off = frame_no * PAGE_SIZE as u64;\n        self.file.write_all_at(data, off)\n    }\n\n    fn sync(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.file.sync_all()\n    }\n}\n\n/// 纯内存后端：帧号 -> 字节。写半帧会真的只存半帧，因此撕裂写可被 CRC 检出。\n#[derive(Default)]\npub struct MemStorage {\n    frames: Mutex<HashMap<u64, Vec<u8>>>,\n    sync_count: Mutex<u64>,\n}\n\nimpl MemStorage {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        Self::default()\n    }\n\n    pub fn sync_count(&self) -> u64 {\n        *self.sync_count.lock().unwrap()\n    }\n\n    /// 快照（帧号排序），供测试检查磁盘镜像。\n    pub fn snapshot(&self) -> Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)> {\n        let frames = self.frames.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut v: Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)> =\n            frames.iter().map(|(k, v)| (*k, v.clone())).collect();\n        v.sort_by_key(|(k, _)| *k);\n        v\n    }\n}\n\nimpl StorageIo for MemStorage {\n    fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        debug_assert_eq!(buf.len(), PAGE_SIZE);\n        let frames = self.frames.lock().unwrap();\n        let frame = frames.get(&frame_no).ok_or_else(|| {\n            io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof, format!(\"no frame {frame_no}\"))\n        })?;\n        if frame.len() != buf.len() {\n            // 典型场景：该帧被撕裂写成半帧。\n            return Err(io::Error::new(\n                io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                format!(\n                    \"frame {frame_no} is {} bytes (expected {PAGE_SIZE}); likely torn\",\n                    frame.len()\n                ),\n            ));\n        }\n        buf.copy_from_slice(frame);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.frames\n            .lock()\n            .unwrap()\n            .insert(frame_no, data.to_vec());\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn sync(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        *self.sync_count.lock().unwrap() += 1;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// 故障计划：所有阈值都是“第 N 次调用（从 1 开始）”；`None` 表示不注入。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct FaultPlan {\n    /// 第 N 次 write 直接返回 EIO（调用不触及内层存储）。\n    pub fail_write_at: Option<u64>,\n    /// 第 N 次 write 只落前半帧且返回成功（撕裂写）。\n    pub torn_write_at: Option<u64>,\n    /// 第 N 次 sync 返回 EIO。\n    pub fail_sync_at: Option<u64>,\n    /// 第 N 次 read 返回 EIO。\n    pub fail_read_at: Option<u64>,\n}\n\n/// 已发生的调用计数。\n#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone)]\npub struct FaultCounters {\n    pub reads: u64,\n    pub writes: u64,\n    pub torn: u64,\n    pub syncs: u64,\n}\n\n/// 故障注入包装层。\npub struct FaultyStorage<S: StorageIo> {\n    inner: S,\n    plan: Arc<Mutex<FaultPlan>>,\n    counters: Mutex<FaultCounters>,\n}\n\nimpl<S: StorageIo> FaultyStorage<S> {\n    pub fn new(inner: S, plan: Arc<Mutex<FaultPlan>>) -> Self {\n        FaultyStorage {\n            inner,\n            plan,\n            counters: Mutex::new(FaultCounters::default()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn counters(&self) -> FaultCounters {\n        self.counters.lock().unwrap().clone()\n    }\n\n    pub fn reset_counters(&self) {\n        *self.counters.lock().unwrap() = FaultCounters::default();\n    }\n\n    fn io_err(msg: &str) -> io::Error {\n        io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::Other, format!(\"injected fault: {msg}\"))\n    }\n}\n\nimpl<S: StorageIo> StorageIo for FaultyStorage<S> {\n    fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let n = {\n            let mut c = self.counters.lock().unwrap();\n            c.reads += 1;\n            c.reads\n        };\n        if self.plan.lock().unwrap().fail_read_at == Some(n) {\n            return Err(Self::io_err(\"read failure\"));\n        }\n        self.inner.read_frame(frame_no, buf)\n    }\n\n    fn write_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let n = {\n            let mut c = self.counters.lock().unwrap();\n            c.writes += 1;\n            c.writes\n        };\n        let plan = self.plan.lock().unwrap().clone();\n        if plan.fail_write_at == Some(n) {\n            return Err(Self::io_err(\"write failure\"));\n        }\n        if plan.torn_write_at == Some(n) {\n            // 只把前半帧交给内层：后半保持旧值/零，CRC 必然失配。\n            let half = data.len() / 2;\n            self.inner.write_frame(frame_no, &data[..half])?;\n            self.counters.lock().unwrap().torn += 1;\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        self.inner.write_frame(frame_no, data)\n    }\n\n    fn sync(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let n = {\n            let mut c = self.counters.lock().unwrap();\n            c.syncs += 1;\n            c.syncs\n        };\n        if self.plan.lock().unwrap().fail_sync_at == Some(n) {\n            return Err(Self::io_err(\"sync failure\"));\n        }\n        self.inner.sync()\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":155,"oldLines":7,"newStart":155,"newLines":9,"lines":["     }"," }"," ","-/// HTTP 验证入口的端到端测试（真实 TCP 回环，纯 std 客户端）。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse pfs::http::Server;\nuse pfs::io::{FaultPlan, FaultyStorage, MemStorage, StorageIo};\nuse pfs::store::Store;\n\nuse common::{extract_id, http_request};\n\n/// 在随机空闲端口启动带故障注入端点的服务器，返回 (join 句柄, 地址)。\nfn spawn_server() -> (std::thread::JoinHandle<()>, String, Arc<Mutex<FaultPlan>>) {\n    let mem = MemStorage::new();\n    let plan = Arc::new(Mutex::new(FaultPlan::default()));\n    let faulty = FaultyStorage::new(mem, Arc::clone(&plan));\n    let io: Arc<dyn StorageIo> = Arc::new(faulty);\n    let store = Arc::new(Store::create(io).unwrap());\n    let server = Server::with_faults(store, Arc::clone(&plan));\n    let listener = std::net::TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();\n    let handle = std::thread::spawn(move || {\n        let _ = server.run_listener(listener);\n    });\n    std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(50));\n    (handle, addr, plan)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_crud_lifecycle_and_errors() {\n    let (_h, addr, _plan) = spawn_server();\n\n    // status：初始空库。\n    let (st, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", \"/status\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200);\n    assert!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&body).contains(\"\\\"npages\\\":0\"));\n\n    // put 三条记录。\n    let mut ids = Vec::new();\n    for payload in [&b\"record-one\"[..], b\"record-two\", b\"xx\"] {\n        let (st, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", payload);\n        assert_eq!(st, 201, \"{}\", String::from_utf8_lossy(&body));\n        ids.push(extract_id(&body));\n    }\n\n    // get：原始字节往返（含非 UTF-8）。\n    let binary = vec![0u8, 1, 2, 255, 254, 128];\n    let (_, _, body) = http_request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", &binary);\n    let bin_id = extract_id(&body);\n    let (st, headers, body) = http_request(&addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records/{bin_id}\"), b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200);\n    assert_eq!(body, binary);\n    assert!(\n        headers\n            .iter()\n            .any(|(k, v)| k.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"content-type\")\n                && v.contains(\"octet-stream\")),\n        \"raw content type expected: {headers:?}\"\n    );\n\n    // delete 成功；重复 用共享快照向量的自定义内存后端，避免 clone 整个 MemStorage。\n    struct Shared(Arc<Mutex<Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)>>>);\n    impl StorageIo for Shared {\n        fn read_frame(&self, frame_no: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            let frames = self.0.lock().unwrap();\n            let f = frames\n                .iter()\n                .find(|(n, _)| *n == frame_no)\n                .ok_or_else(|| {\n                    std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof, \"no frame\")\n                })?;\n            if f.1.len() != buf.len() {\n                return Err(std::io::Error::new(\n                    std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                    format!(\"frame {} torn: {} bytes\", frame_no, f.1.len()),\n                ));\n            }\n self.0.lock().unwrap();\n            if let Some(slot) = frames.iter_mut().find(|(n, _)| *n == frame_no) {\n                slot.1 = data.to_vec();\n            } else {\n                frames.push((frame_no, data.to_vec()));\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        fn sync(&self) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            Ok(())\n        }\n    }\n\n    let frames = };\n    let err = store.put(b\"should-not-land\").unwrap_err();\n    assert!(err.to_string().to_lowercase().contains(\"injected fault\"), \"{err}\");\n\n    // 清除故障：存储状态没有被半成品污染。\n    *plan.lock().unwrap() = FaultPlan::default();\n    assert_eq!(store.get(&id1).unwrap(), b\"first-record\");\n    assert!(store.get(\"p1s99g1\").is_err());\n\n    // 后续写正常工作。\n    let id2 = store.put(b\"after-recovery\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(store.get(&id2).unwrap(), b\"after-recovery\");\n    assert_eq!(store.status().live_records, 2);\n\n    // 磁盘镜像里每个帧都是完整的 PAGE_SIZE（没有半帧残留）。\n let torn_len = frames\n        .lock()\n        .unwrap()\n        .iter()\n        .find(|(n, _)| *n == 1)\n        .map(|(_, f)| f.len())\n        .unwrap();\n    assert!(torn_len < &mut [u8]) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            let frames = self.0.lock().unwrap();\n            let f = frames\n                .iter()\n                .find(|(n, _)| *n == frame_no)\n std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                    format!(\"frame {frame_no} torn: {}\", f.1.len()),\n                ));\n            }\n            buf.copy_from_slice(&f.1);\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        fn write_frame(&self, _: u64, _: &[u8]) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        fn sync(&self) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n            Ok(())\n        }\n    }\n    let io: Arc<dyn StorageIo> = Arc::new(Shared2(frames));\n    let msg = match Store::open(io) {\n        Err(e) => e.to_string().to_lowercase(),\n        Ok(_) => panic!(\"expected corruption error, reopen succeeded\"),\n    };\n    assert!(\n        msg.contains(\"crc\") || msg.contains(\"torn\") || msg.contains(\"corrupt\"),\n        \"expected corruption error, got: {msg}\"\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn sync_failure_is_surfaced() {\n    let mem = MemStorage::new();\n    let plan = Arc::new(Mutex::new(FaultPlan {\n        fail_sync_at: Some(1),\n        ..Default::default()\n    }));\n    let before = mem.sync_count();\n    let faulty = FaultyStorage::new(mem, plan);\n    let io: Arc<dyn StorageIo> = Arc::new(faulty);\n    let store = Store::create(io).unwrap();\n    let err injected failure (baseline count was {before})\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn read_failure_on_open_is_surfaced() {\n    // 打开存储时注入读错误：必须明确返回 I/O 错误而非 panic。\n    let mem = MemStorage::new();\n    // 先造一个超级块。\n
